vi.R: Năm thứ tư đời Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a làm vua Giu-đa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Giê-rê-mi sứ điệp này:

ko.L: 그리고 유다 왕 요시야의 아들 여호야김의 제4년에, 이 말씀이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 예레미야에게 임하여 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 요시야의 아들 여호야김이 유다를 다스린 지 4년째 되는 해에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예레미야에게 이 말씀을 주셨다.
ko.R: 요시야의 아들 여호야김이 유다의 왕이 된 지 4년째 되는 해에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예레미야에게 이 말씀을 주셨다.

decisions.choice: the fourth year of Jehoiakim: 605 BC, the year of 25:1
decisions.reason: Jehoiakim became king in 609 BC, so his fourth year was 605 BC, the year Nebuchadrezzar defeated Egypt at Carchemish and became king of Babylon (25:1; 46:2). The short word to Baruch in 45:1 is dated to this same year, "when he wrote these words in a scroll at Jeremiah's dictation".

decisions.choice: chapter 36 of the Hebrew is chapter 43 of the Greek translation
decisions.reason: Because the Greek translation (the Septuagint) places the oracles against the nations after 25:13, this chapter stands later there (see 1:1). The Greek of this chapter is also somewhat shorter. The Hebrew text is followed here.

decisions.choice: the word came ... saying: the heading of a new account, told about Jeremiah rather than by him
decisions.reason: The chapter is a narrative in the third person, like chapters 26 and 28. "Saying" introduces the LORD's command in verses 2-3.

decisions.choice: this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying: (L); This message came to Jeremiah from the LORD (B); the LORD gave Jeremiah this message (R)
decisions.reason: The heading is worded as the book's settled formula for "the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD", with "this" kept from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: vino esta palabra a Jeremías de parte del SEÑOR, diciendo: (L); Este mensaje vino a Jeremías de parte del SEÑOR (B); el SEÑOR le dio a Jeremías este mensaje (R)
decisions.reason: The heading formula set for Jeremiah, with the date.

decisions.choice: "유다 왕 X의 제4년에" (L); "X가 다스린 지 4년째 되는 해에" (B); "X가 왕이 된 지 4년째 되는 해에" (R), years in figures
decisions.reason: The terms note's dated heading, with years in figures at every level.

source.text: קַח־לְךָ֮ מְגִלַּת־סֵפֶר֒ וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ אֵלֶ֗יהָ אֵ֣ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֧רְתִּי אֵלֶ֛יךָ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל וְעַל־יְהוּדָ֖ה וְעַל־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם מִיּ֞וֹם דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ מִימֵ֣י יֹאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Take for yourself [a] scroll of [a] book and write on it all the words that I have spoken to you concerning Israel and concerning Judah and concerning all the nations, from [the] day I spoke to you, from [the] days of Josiah, and until the day this.

en.L: "Take for yourself a scroll of a book and write on it all the words that I have spoken to you concerning Israel and concerning Judah and concerning all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah, until this day.
en.B: "Take a scroll and write on it every word that I have spoken to you about Israel, about Judah and about all the nations, from the day I first spoke to you in the days of Josiah until today.
en.R: "Get a scroll and write on it everything I have told you about Israel, about Judah and about all the other nations. Write down all I have said from the time I first spoke to you, when Josiah was king, until now.

es.L: «Toma para ti un rollo de libro y escribe en él todas las palabras que te he hablado acerca de Israel y acerca de Judá y acerca de todas las naciones, desde el día en que te hablé, desde los días de Josías, hasta este día.
es.B: «Toma un rollo y escribe en él todas las palabras que te he dicho acerca de Israel, de Judá y de todas las naciones, desde el día en que te hablé por primera vez, en tiempos de Josías, hasta hoy.
es.R: «Consigue un rollo y escribe en él todo lo que te he dicho acerca de Israel, de Judá y de todas las demás naciones. Escribe todo lo que he dicho desde la primera vez que te hablé, cuando Josías era rey, hasta ahora.

fr.L: « Prends-toi un rouleau de livre et écris dessus toutes les paroles que je t’ai dites concernant Israël, et concernant Juda, et concernant toutes les nations, depuis le jour où je t’ai parlé, depuis les jours de Josias, jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: « Prends un rouleau et écris dessus toutes les paroles que je t’ai dites au sujet d’Israël, de Juda et de toutes les nations, depuis le jour où je t’ai parlé pour la première fois, au temps de Josias, jusqu’à aujourd’hui.
fr.R: « Procure-toi un rouleau et écris dessus tout ce que je t’ai dit au sujet d’Israël, de Juda et de toutes les autres nations. Écris tout ce que j’ai dit depuis la première fois que je t’ai parlé, quand Josias était roi, jusqu’à maintenant.

sw.L: "Jitwalie gombo la kitabu, uandike ndani yake maneno yote niliyokuambia juu ya Israeli na juu ya Yuda na juu ya mataifa yote, tangu siku nilipoanza kusema nawe, tangu siku za Yosia, mpaka siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: "Chukua gombo, uandike ndani yake kila neno nililokuambia kuhusu Israeli, kuhusu Yuda na kuhusu mataifa yote, tangu siku nilipoanza kusema nawe wakati wa Yosia mpaka leo.
sw.R: "Chukua gombo, uandike ndani yake yote niliyokuambia kuhusu Israeli, kuhusu Yuda na kuhusu mataifa mengine yote. Andika yote niliyosema tangu nilipoanza kusema nawe, wakati Yosia alipokuwa mfalme, mpaka sasa.

vi.L: "Hãy lấy cho ngươi một cuộn sách, và chép vào đó mọi lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán với ngươi về Y-sơ-ra-ên, về Giu-đa và về mọi dân tộc, từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phán với ngươi, từ những ngày Giô-si-a, cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: "Con hãy lấy một cuộn sách và chép vào đó mọi lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán với con về Y-sơ-ra-ên, về Giu-đa và về mọi dân tộc, từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bắt đầu phán với con trong thời Giô-si-a cho đến hôm nay.
vi.R: "Con hãy lấy một cuộn sách và chép vào đó mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói với con về Y-sơ-ra-ên, về Giu-đa và về mọi dân tộc khác. Hãy chép lại hết những gì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán từ lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bắt đầu nói với con, khi Giô-si-a còn làm vua, cho đến bây giờ.

ko.L: "너는 두루마리 책을 가져다가, 내가 너에게 말한 날부터, 곧 요시야의 시대부터 오늘까지 이스라엘과 유다와 모든 민족에 관하여 너에게 말한 모든 말을 거기에 기록하여라.
ko.B: "두루마리를 가져다가, 요시야 때에 내가 너에게 처음 말한 날부터 오늘까지 이스라엘과 유다와 모든 민족에 관하여 너에게 한 말을 모두 거기에 적어라.
ko.R: "두루마리를 하나 가져오너라. 내가 이스라엘과 유다와 다른 모든 나라에 관하여 너에게 한 말을 모두 거기에 적어라. 요시야가 왕이었을 때 내가 너에게 처음 말한 때부터 지금까지 한 말을 모두 적어라.

decisions.choice: a scroll of a book: a scroll made for writing a document
decisions.reason: A scroll was a long strip of leather or papyrus sheets joined together and rolled up. The second word means a written document; joined to "scroll" it says what the roll is for. The same two words return in verse 4, and later verses say simply "the scroll".

decisions.choice: from the days of Josiah: from Jeremiah's call in Josiah's thirteenth year, 627 BC
decisions.reason: Jeremiah began to prophesy in the thirteenth year of Josiah (1:2), some twenty-three years before this command (25:3). The scroll is to hold the whole of his message up to now.

decisions.choice: concerning: about, and in most of the words against, Israel, Judah and the nations
decisions.reason: The small word can mean "about" or "against". Most of what Jeremiah had spoken was warning of judgment, but the scroll also held his calls to turn back (verse 3).

decisions.choice: Israel: the Greek translation reads "Jerusalem"
decisions.reason: The Septuagint has "concerning Jerusalem and concerning Judah". The Hebrew "Israel" fits Jeremiah's early words to the northern tribes (3:6-13) and to the whole people. The Hebrew is followed.

decisions.choice: first (Balanced, Readable); other nations (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "first" to make clear that the day meant is the day of Jeremiah's call. Readable adds "other" because Israel and Judah are nations too.

decisions.choice: un rollo de libro (L); un rollo (B, R)
decisions.reason: The scroll is "el rollo" in this translation, as Luke 4:17; Literal keeps "rollo de libro" for the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: "gombo la kitabu" (L); "gombo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The scroll is "gombo" at every level, the word of Luke 4:17; Literal keeps "of a book" as "la kitabu".

decisions.choice: "un rouleau de livre" (L); "un rouleau" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for the scroll in French Jeremiah: Literal keeps "of a book", a scroll made for writing a document.

decisions.choice: cuộn sách
decisions.reason: The scroll is "cuộn sách", as the terms note sets (Luke 4:17): a roll, not a bound book.

decisions.choice: ngươi (L); con (B, R)
decisions.reason: God speaking to Jeremiah alone says "ngươi" at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable, as the terms note sets for one person.

decisions.choice: "두루마리 책" (L); "두루마리" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for the scroll [Heb 10:7; 1 Sam 10:25]. Where the Hebrew says only "the book" (verses 8, 10, 11), Korean says "두루마리" at every level, as the English does.

source.text: אוּלַ֤י יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י חֹשֵׁ֖ב לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן יָשׁ֗וּבוּ אִ֚ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֔ה וְסָלַחְתִּ֥י לַעֲוֺנָ֖ם וּלְחַטָּאתָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Perhaps will hear [the] house of Judah all the evil that I [am] planning to do to them, so that they may turn, each from his way the evil, and I will forgive their iniquity and their sin.

en.L: Perhaps the house of Judah will hear all the evil that I am planning to do to them, so that they turn back, each [one] from {{gender:their|his}} evil way, and I will forgive their iniquity and their sin."
en.B: It may be that when the house of Judah hears about all the disaster I intend to bring on them, every one of them will turn back from their evil way, and I will forgive their guilt and their sin."
en.R: Maybe when the people of Judah hear about all the terrible things I plan to do to them, each of them will turn away from their evil way of life. Then I will forgive their sin and all the wrong they have done."

es.L: Quizá oiga la casa de Judá todo el mal que yo pienso hacerles, para que se vuelvan cada uno de su mal camino, y yo perdone su iniquidad y su pecado».
es.B: Tal vez, cuando la casa de Judá oiga toda la calamidad que me propongo traer sobre ellos, cada uno se vuelva de su mal camino, y yo perdone su culpa y su pecado».
es.R: Tal vez cuando el pueblo de Judá oiga todas las cosas terribles que pienso hacerles, cada uno deje su mala manera de vivir. Entonces yo les perdonaré su pecado y todo el mal que han hecho».

fr.L: Peut-être la maison de Juda entendra-t-elle tout le mal que je projette de leur faire, afin qu’ils reviennent, chacun de sa mauvaise voie, et je pardonnerai leur iniquité et leur péché. »
fr.B: Peut-être que, lorsque la maison de Juda entendra parler de tout le malheur que j’ai l’intention de leur envoyer, chacun d’eux reviendra de sa mauvaise conduite, et je pardonnerai leur faute et leur péché. »
fr.R: Peut-être que, quand les gens de Juda entendront parler de toutes les choses terribles que je compte leur faire, chacun d’eux se détournera de sa mauvaise conduite. Alors je pardonnerai leur péché et tout le mal qu’ils ont fait. »

sw.L: Huenda nyumba ya Yuda itasikia mabaya yote ninayokusudia kuwatendea, ili warudi, kila mtu kutoka katika njia yake mbaya, nami nitawasamehe uovu wao na dhambi yao."
sw.B: Huenda watu wa nyumba ya Yuda watakaposikia juu ya maafa yote ninayokusudia kuleta juu yao, kila mmoja wao atarudi kutoka katika njia yake mbaya, nami nitawasamehe hatia yao na dhambi yao."
sw.R: Labda watu wa Yuda watakaposikia juu ya mambo yote mabaya sana ninayopanga kuwatendea, kila mmoja wao ataacha njia zake mbaya. Ndipo nitawasamehe dhambi zao na mabaya yote waliyoyatenda."

vi.L: Có lẽ nhà Giu-đa sẽ nghe về mọi tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} định giáng trên chúng, để mỗi người quay lại khỏi đường ác của mình, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha thứ tội ác và tội lỗi của chúng."
vi.B: Có thể khi nhà Giu-đa nghe về mọi tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} định giáng trên chúng, mỗi người sẽ quay lại khỏi đường ác của mình, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha thứ lỗi lầm và tội lỗi của chúng."
vi.R: Có lẽ khi dân Giu-đa nghe về mọi điều khủng khiếp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} định làm cho chúng, mỗi người sẽ từ bỏ lối sống gian ác của mình. Khi ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha thứ tội lỗi và mọi điều sai trái chúng đã làm."

ko.L: 혹시 유다 집이 내가 그들에게 행하려고 계획하는 모든 재앙을 듣고, 각자 자기의 악한 길에서 돌아올지도 모른다. 그러면 내가 그들의 죄악과 그들의 죄를 용서하겠다."
ko.B: 유다 집이 내가 그들에게 내리려고 하는 모든 재앙에 관하여 들으면, 혹시 저마다 악한 길에서 돌아올지도 모른다. 그러면 나는 그들의 허물과 죄를 용서하겠다."
ko.R: 유다 백성이 내가 그들에게 하려는 무서운 일들에 관하여 들으면, 어쩌면 저마다 악하게 살던 길에서 돌아설지도 모른다. 그러면 나는 그들의 죄와 그들이 저지른 모든 잘못을 용서하겠다."

decisions.choice: the evil I am planning: disaster, set against the people's evil way
decisions.reason: The same word names the harm the LORD plans and the wrong the people do. The disaster answers their evil; if they turn from their evil, the disaster can be turned aside (18:8; 26:3).

decisions.choice: perhaps ... so that they turn ... and I will forgive: the writing is a last call to repent
decisions.reason: The LORD does not say they will listen, but he leaves room for it. The scroll is meant to bring the people back and so to bring forgiveness, not only to record a sentence. Verse 31 says they did not listen.

decisions.choice: iniquity and sin: two words for wrongdoing, together meaning all their guilt
decisions.reason: The first word names wrongdoing with the guilt it brings, the second a failing or offense. Paired, they cover the whole of what needs forgiving.

decisions.choice: the evil (L); disaster, terrible things (B, R); iniquity (L), guilt (B), sin (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "evil" twice to show the play on words (m1); Balanced and Readable say "disaster" for the harm the LORD plans. The word for iniquity follows the wording used for Isaiah. Readable says "the people of Judah" for "the house of Judah". Literal uses a gender setting because the whole people, women and men, is meant.

decisions.choice: el mal (L); la calamidad, las cosas terribles (B, R); iniquidad (L), culpa (B), pecado ... el mal que han hecho (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "mal" for both God's disaster and the people's evil, as the Hebrew does; Balanced and Readable say what the disaster is.

decisions.choice: "mabaya" (L), "maafa" (B), "mambo mabaya sana" (R); "uovu" (L), "hatia" (B), "dhambi" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the one word for the people's evil and God's "evil", while Balanced and Readable show that what God plans is disaster.

decisions.choice: tai họa (L, B); điều khủng khiếp (R)
decisions.reason: The "evil" God plans is disaster, not wrongdoing; Vietnamese says "tai họa" at every level but Readable, setting it against "đường ác" (evil way).

decisions.choice: "재앙" (L, B), "무서운 일들" (R) for "the evil" God plans; "죄악" (L), "허물" (B), "잘못" (R) for iniquity
decisions.reason: Korean "악" would make God plan wickedness; the meaning decision says the word means disaster here, set against their evil way.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶת־בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּן־נֵֽרִיָּ֑ה וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב בָּר֜וּךְ מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלָ֖יו עַל־מְגִלַּת־סֵֽפֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And called Jeremiah Baruch son of Neriah, and wrote Baruch from [the] mouth of Jeremiah all [the] words of Yahweh that he had spoken to him on [a] scroll of [a] book.

en.L: And Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had spoken to him, on a scroll of a book.
en.B: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and as Jeremiah dictated, Baruch wrote down on a scroll everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken to him.
en.R: So Jeremiah sent for Baruch son of Neriah. Jeremiah spoke all the words {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had given him, and Baruch wrote them down on a scroll.

es.L: Y llamó Jeremías a Baruc hijo de Nerías, y escribió Baruc de la boca de Jeremías todas las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le había hablado, en un rollo de libro.
es.B: Entonces Jeremías llamó a Baruc hijo de Nerías, y mientras Jeremías le dictaba, Baruc escribió en un rollo todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había hablado.
es.R: Así que Jeremías mandó llamar a Baruc hijo de Nerías. Jeremías repitió todas las palabras que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dado, y Baruc las escribió en un rollo.

fr.L: Et Jérémie appela Baruch fils de Nériya, et Baruch écrivit de la bouche de Jérémie toutes les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui avait dites, sur un rouleau de livre.
fr.B: Jérémie appela donc Baruch fils de Nériya, et Baruch écrivit sur un rouleau, sous la dictée de Jérémie, toutes les paroles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait dites.
fr.R: Jérémie a donc fait venir Baruch fils de Nériya. Jérémie a dit toutes les paroles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait données, et Baruch les a écrites sur un rouleau.

sw.L: Basi Yeremia akamwita Baruku mwana wa Neria, naye Baruku akaandika kutoka kinywani mwa Yeremia maneno yote ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyokuwa amemwambia, katika gombo la kitabu.
sw.B: Basi Yeremia akamwita Baruku mwana wa Neria, na Yeremia alipokuwa akisoma maneno kwa sauti, Baruku akaandika katika gombo yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemwambia.
sw.R: Basi Yeremia akamwita Baruku mwana wa Neria. Yeremia akasema maneno yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amempa, naye Baruku akayaandika katika gombo.

vi.L: Giê-rê-mi gọi Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia, và Ba-rúc chép từ miệng Giê-rê-mi mọi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với ông vào một cuộn sách.
vi.B: Vậy Giê-rê-mi gọi Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia đến, và Giê-rê-mi đọc cho Ba-rúc chép vào cuộn sách mọi lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với ông.
vi.R: Vậy Giê-rê-mi cho gọi Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia. Giê-rê-mi nói ra mọi lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho ông, và Ba-rúc chép lại vào một cuộn sách.

ko.L: 그래서 예레미야가 네리야의 아들 바룩을 불렀고, 바룩이 예레미야의 입에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 하신 모든 말씀을 두루마리 책에 기록했다.
ko.B: 그래서 예레미야가 네리야의 아들 바룩을 불렀다. 예레미야가 불러 주는 대로, 바룩은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예레미야에게 하신 모든 말씀을 두루마리에 받아 적었다.
ko.R: 그래서 예레미야는 네리야의 아들 바룩을 불렀다. 예레미야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주신 모든 말씀을 소리 내어 말하자, 바룩이 그것을 두루마리에 받아 적었다.

decisions.choice: from the mouth of Jeremiah: at Jeremiah's dictation
decisions.reason: To write "from the mouth of" someone is to write down what he says aloud (verses 6, 17-18, 27, 32). The words are the LORD's, spoken to Jeremiah; Jeremiah speaks them, and Baruch writes.

decisions.choice: Baruch son of Neriah: Jeremiah's scribe and companion
decisions.reason: Baruch had signed and kept the deed of Jeremiah's field (32:12-16), went with him to Egypt (43:3-6), and received a word of his own from the LORD (45:1-5). His brother Seraiah served King Zedekiah (51:59).

decisions.choice: as Jeremiah dictated (Balanced); Jeremiah spoke ... and Baruch wrote them down (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m1); Literal keeps "from the mouth of".

decisions.choice: mientras Jeremías le dictaba (B); Jeremías repitió ... y Baruc las escribió (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "from the mouth of", that Jeremiah dictated; Literal keeps the idiom.

decisions.choice: Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia
decisions.reason: A new name for these books; the form follows the terms note. Luke 3:27's Nê-ri is a different name.

decisions.choice: "예레미야가 불러 주는 대로 ... 받아 적었다" (B); "소리 내어 말하자 ... 받아 적었다" (R) for "from the mouth of Jeremiah"
decisions.reason: "불러 주다" and "받아 적다" are the everyday Korean words for dictation; Literal keeps "예레미야의 입에서".

source.text: וַיְצַוֶּ֣ה יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶת־בָּר֖וּךְ לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֣י עָצ֔וּר לֹ֣א אוּכַ֔ל לָב֖וֹא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And commanded Jeremiah Baruch, saying, I [am] restrained; not I am able to go [into the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, "I [am] restrained; I am not able to go into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Then Jeremiah gave Baruch these instructions: "I am barred; I cannot go into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then Jeremiah told Baruch, "I have been kept away. I am not allowed to go into {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple.

es.L: Y mandó Jeremías a Baruc, diciendo: «Yo [estoy] impedido; no puedo entrar en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Luego Jeremías le dio a Baruc estas instrucciones: «A mí me han prohibido la entrada; no puedo ir a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Después Jeremías le dijo a Baruc: «A mí no me dejan ir. No se me permite entrar en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Jérémie commanda à Baruch, disant : « Je [suis] empêché ; je ne peux pas entrer dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Puis Jérémie donna ces instructions à Baruch : « Je suis empêché ; je ne peux pas entrer dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Puis Jérémie a dit à Baruch : « On m’a écarté. Je n’ai pas le droit d’entrer dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kisha Yeremia akamwagiza Baruku, kusema, "Mimi [nimezuiwa]; siwezi kuingia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kisha Yeremia akampa Baruku maagizo haya: "Mimi nimezuiliwa; siwezi kuingia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kisha Yeremia akamwambia Baruku, "Nimezuiliwa. Siruhusiwi kuingia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Giê-rê-mi truyền cho Ba-rúc rằng: "Tôi bị ngăn cấm; tôi không thể vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Rồi Giê-rê-mi dặn Ba-rúc: "Tôi bị cấm, không được vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Rồi Giê-rê-mi bảo Ba-rúc: "Tôi bị ngăn không cho đến gần. Tôi không được phép vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 예레미야가 바룩에게 명령하여 말했다. "나는 갇혀 [있어서] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어갈 수 없다.
ko.B: 그리고 예레미야가 바룩에게 이렇게 지시했다. "나는 출입을 금지당하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어갈 수 없다.
ko.R: 그리고 예레미야가 바룩에게 말했다. "나는 성전에 가지 못하게 되었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 들어가는 것이 허락되지 않는다.

decisions.choice: restrained: kept from going, not shut up in prison
decisions.reason: The word means held back or shut in. Elsewhere it is used of Jeremiah confined in the court of the guard (33:1; 39:15), but here he is free to go into hiding (verses 19, 26). The reason he was barred from the temple is not given; it may have been a ban after his temple sermon (26:7-11) or after Pashhur had him beaten and put in the stocks (20:1-3), or some passing hindrance.

decisions.choice: I am restrained; I cannot go: the reason Baruch must go in his place
decisions.reason: The two clauses explain the command of verse 6, where the "you" is stressed: you go, since I cannot.

decisions.choice: barred (Balanced); kept away (Readable)
decisions.reason: These words say that Jeremiah was prevented from going without suggesting he was in prison (m1). Readable says "temple" for the house of the LORD, as it does throughout.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah speaks to Baruch, his scribe, in 해라체
decisions.reason: Jeremiah is Baruch's master in the work; the officials and Baruch speak to each other in 하오체 and 합쇼체 (verses 15-19).

source.text: וּבָאתָ֣ אַתָּ֡ה וְקָרָ֣אתָ בַמְּגִלָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־כָּתַֽבְתָּ־מִפִּי֩ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה בְּאָזְנֵ֥י הָעָ֛ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה בְּי֣וֹם צ֑וֹם וְגַ֨ם בְּאָזְנֵ֧י כָל־יְהוּדָ֛ה הַבָּאִ֥ים מֵעָרֵיהֶ֖ם תִּקְרָאֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And go you and read in the scroll which you have written from my mouth the words of Yahweh in [the] ears of the people [in the] house of Yahweh on [a] day of fasting; and also in [the] ears of all Judah the coming from their cities you shall read them.

en.L: So you go, and read from the scroll that you have written from my mouth the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the ears of the people in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on a day of fasting; and also in the ears of all Judah who come from their cities you shall read them.
en.B: So you must go, and on a fast day read the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the scroll you wrote at my dictation, in the hearing of the people in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Read them also in the hearing of all the people of Judah who come in from their towns.
en.R: So you go to the temple on a day when the people are fasting. Read the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the scroll that you wrote as I spoke. Read them to the people there, and to all the people of Judah who come in from their towns.

es.L: Así que ve tú y lee en el rollo que escribiste de mi boca las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a oídos del pueblo en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en un día de ayuno; y también a oídos de todo Judá que viene de sus ciudades las leerás.
es.B: Así que ve tú, y en un día de ayuno lee las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} del rollo que escribiste a mi dictado, para que las oiga el pueblo en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Léelas también para que las oiga toda la gente de Judá que viene de sus pueblos.
es.R: Por eso ve tú al templo un día en que la gente esté ayunando. Lee las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} del rollo que escribiste mientras yo hablaba. Léeselas a la gente que esté allí y a toda la gente de Judá que llegue de sus pueblos.

fr.L: Toi donc, va, et lis dans le rouleau que tu as écrit de ma bouche les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} aux oreilles du peuple dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en un jour de jeûne ; et aussi aux oreilles de tout Juda, de ceux qui viennent de leurs villes, tu les liras.
fr.B: Toi, tu iras donc, un jour de jeûne, lire les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans le rouleau que tu as écrit sous ma dictée, en présence du peuple, dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Lis-les aussi devant tous les gens de Juda qui viennent de leurs villes.
fr.R: Toi, tu iras au temple un jour où le peuple jeûne. Lis les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans le rouleau que tu as écrit pendant que je parlais. Lis-les aux gens qui seront là, et à tous les gens de Juda qui viennent de leurs villes.

sw.L: Basi wewe nenda, ukasome katika gombo uliloandika kutoka kinywani mwangu maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} masikioni mwa watu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku ya kufunga; tena utayasoma masikioni mwa Yuda wote wanaokuja kutoka miji yao.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo wewe nenda, na siku ya kufunga uyasome maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka katika gombo uliloandika nilipokusomea, watu wakisikia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Uyasome pia mbele ya watu wote wa Yuda wanaokuja kutoka miji yao.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo wewe nenda hekaluni siku ambayo watu wanafunga. Soma maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka katika gombo uliloandika nilipokuwa nikisema. Wasomee watu walioko huko, na watu wote wa Yuda wanaokuja kutoka miji yao.

vi.L: Vậy chính anh hãy đi, và đọc trong cuộn sách anh đã chép từ miệng tôi những lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào tai dân chúng trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào ngày kiêng ăn; anh cũng sẽ đọc chúng vào tai cả Giu-đa, những người từ các thành của họ đến.
vi.B: Vậy anh hãy đi, và vào ngày kiêng ăn, hãy đọc những lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong cuộn sách anh đã chép theo lời tôi đọc, cho dân chúng trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe. Hãy đọc cho mọi người Giu-đa từ các thành của họ đến cũng nghe nữa.
vi.R: Vậy anh hãy đến đền thờ vào ngày dân chúng kiêng ăn. Hãy đọc những lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong cuộn sách anh đã chép khi tôi nói. Hãy đọc cho dân chúng ở đó nghe, và cho mọi người Giu-đa từ các thành của họ đến cũng nghe.

ko.L: 그러니 너는 가서, 금식하는 날에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 백성의 귀에, 내 입에서 받아 기록한 그 두루마리에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 읽어라. 또한 자기 성읍들에서 오는 온 유다의 귀에도 그것을 읽어라.
ko.B: 그러니 네가 가거라. 금식하는 날에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서, 내가 불러 주어 네가 기록한 그 두루마리에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 백성에게 읽어 들려주어라. 자기 성읍에서 올라오는 유다 모든 사람에게도 읽어 들려주어라.
ko.R: 그러니 네가 사람들이 금식하는 날에 성전으로 가거라. 내가 말한 것을 네가 받아 적은 그 두루마리에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 읽어라. 거기 있는 백성에게, 그리고 자기 성읍에서 올라온 유다의 모든 사람에게 그 말씀을 읽어 주어라.

decisions.choice: you: stressed, you in my place
decisions.reason: The pronoun is written out, which in Hebrew gives it weight. Because Jeremiah cannot go (verse 5), Baruch must go for him.

decisions.choice: in the ears of: aloud, so that they hear
decisions.reason: To read "in the ears of" people is to read to them aloud. The phrase returns through the chapter (verses 10, 13-15, 20-21).

decisions.choice: a day of fasting: a day called for prayer in time of danger, when crowds came to the temple
decisions.reason: A public fast was proclaimed when the people faced disaster, and people came in from the towns to pray (verse 9; 14:12; Joel 1:14). On such a day the largest crowd would hear the words.

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: The word for "cities" covers walled places of every size. Balanced and Readable say "towns" for the places of Judah outside Jerusalem. Readable puts the reading in the temple first and says "as I spoke" for "from my mouth".

decisions.choice: a oídos de (L); para que las oiga (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "in the ears of", reading aloud so that people hear; Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

decisions.choice: anh (for Baruch); tôi (Jeremiah)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah speaks to his scribe and companion as "anh", a friend and co-worker, and says "tôi" for himself; Baruch answers others as "tôi".

source.text: אוּלַ֞י תִּפֹּ֤ל תְּחִנָּתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְיָשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֑ה כִּֽי־גָד֤וֹל הָאַף֙ וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Perhaps will fall their supplication before Yahweh and they will turn, each from his way the evil, for great [is] the anger and the wrath that has spoken Yahweh against the people this.

en.L: Perhaps their supplication will fall before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they will turn back, each [one] from {{gender:their|his}} evil way, for great [is] the anger and the wrath that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken against this people."
en.B: It may be that their plea for mercy will come before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and every one of them will turn back from their evil way. For the anger and fury that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has declared against this people are great."
en.R: Maybe they will humbly ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for mercy, and each of them will turn away from their evil way of life. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has said that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is very angry with these people, and that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fury is great."

es.L: Quizá caiga su súplica delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y se vuelvan cada uno de su mal camino, porque grande [es] la ira y el furor que ha hablado {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} contra este pueblo».
es.B: Tal vez su ruego llegue delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y cada uno se vuelva de su mal camino. Porque grandes son la ira y el furor que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha anunciado contra este pueblo».
es.R: Tal vez le pidan humildemente {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} que tenga compasión, y cada uno deje su mala manera de vivir. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dicho que está muy enojado con esta gente, y que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} furor es grande».

fr.L: Peut-être leur supplication tombera-t-elle devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et reviendront-ils, chacun de sa mauvaise voie, car grande [est] la colère et la fureur que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a prononcée contre ce peuple. »
fr.B: Peut-être leur prière pour obtenir grâce parviendra-t-elle devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et chacun d’eux reviendra-t-il de sa mauvaise conduite. Car la colère et la fureur que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a annoncées contre ce peuple sont grandes. »
fr.R: Peut-être qu’ils supplieront humblement {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} d’avoir pitié d’eux, et que chacun d’eux se détournera de sa mauvaise conduite. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est très en colère contre ces gens et que {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur est grande. »

sw.L: Huenda dua yao itaanguka mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao watarudi, kila mtu kutoka katika njia yake mbaya, kwa maana hasira na ghadhabu ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameisema juu ya watu hawa ni kubwa."
sw.B: Huenda maombi yao ya kuomba rehema yatafika mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kila mmoja wao atarudi kutoka katika njia yake mbaya. Kwa maana hasira na ghadhabu ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameitangaza juu ya watu hawa ni kubwa."
sw.R: Labda watamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} rehema kwa unyenyekevu, na kila mmoja wao ataacha njia zake mbaya. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema kwamba amewakasirikia sana watu hawa, na kwamba ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ni kubwa."

vi.L: Có lẽ lời khẩn cầu của họ sẽ thấu đến trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và mỗi người sẽ quay lại khỏi đường ác của mình, vì cơn giận và cơn thịnh nộ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán nghịch cùng dân này thật lớn lắm."
vi.B: Có thể lời cầu xin thương xót của họ sẽ thấu đến trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và mỗi người sẽ quay lại khỏi đường ác của mình. Vì cơn giận và cơn thịnh nộ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã công bố nghịch cùng dân này thật lớn lắm."
vi.R: Có lẽ họ sẽ hạ mình cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thương xót, và mỗi người sẽ từ bỏ lối sống gian ác của mình. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rất giận dân này, và cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn."

ko.L: 혹시 그들의 간구가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 떨어지고, 그들이 각자 자기의 악한 길에서 돌아올지도 모른다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 백성에게 선언하신 진노와 분노가 크기 때문이다."
ko.B: 혹시 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 자비를 간구하고, 저마다 악한 길에서 돌아올지도 모른다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 백성에게 선언하신 진노와 분노가 정말 크기 때문이다."
ko.R: 어쩌면 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 겸손하게 자비를 구하고, 저마다 악하게 살던 길에서 돌아설지도 모른다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이 백성에게 몹시 노하셨고 그분의 분노가 크다고 말씀하셨다."

decisions.choice: their supplication will fall before the LORD: their humble plea will come before him and be heard
decisions.reason: A plea that "falls before" someone is laid down before him humbly, as a person falls down before a king, in hope that it will be accepted. The same phrase returns in 37:20 and 42:2, 9.

decisions.choice: the anger and the wrath: two words together for burning fury
decisions.reason: The first word is anger, pictured as a flaring nose; the second is heat, rage. Together they stress how great the danger is, which is why the people must plead.

decisions.choice: perhaps: the plea and the turning go together
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, the hope is that the people will both pray and change their ways. Jeremiah repeats the LORD's "perhaps" in his own words.

decisions.choice: the LORD has said that he is very angry ... and that his fury is great
decisions.reason: Readable puts "the anger ... that the LORD has spoken" as a plain statement of what the LORD has said.

decisions.choice: caiga su súplica delante del SEÑOR
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the plea "falling" before God; Balanced says it "llegue" and Readable gives the sense.

decisions.choice: "dua yao itaanguka mbele ya BWANA" (L); "maombi yao ... yatafika mbele ya BWANA" (B); "watamwomba BWANA rehema kwa unyenyekevu" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of a plea that "falls" before God; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: lời khẩn cầu của họ sẽ thấu đến trước mặt CHÚA
alternatives: lời khẩn cầu sẽ rơi trước mặt
decisions.reason: Their plea "falls before" the LORD: it comes before him to be heard. "Thấu đến" says that in Vietnamese; "rơi" would mean it fails.

decisions.choice: "그들의 간구가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 떨어지고" (L); "자비를 간구하고" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of a plea that falls before God; the meaning decision explains it.

source.text: וַיַּ֗עַשׂ בָּרוּךְ֙ בֶּן־נֵ֣רִיָּ֔ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖הוּ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא לִקְרֹ֥א בַסֵּ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And did Baruch son of Neriah according to all that commanded him Jeremiah the prophet, to read in the book [the] words of Yahweh [in the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And Baruch son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading from the scroll the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Baruch son of Neriah did everything the prophet Jeremiah had commanded him: he read the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the scroll in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Baruch son of Neriah did everything the prophet Jeremiah told him to do. He read the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the scroll in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple.

es.L: E hizo Baruc hijo de Nerías conforme a todo lo que le mandó Jeremías el profeta, leyendo en el rollo las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Baruc hijo de Nerías hizo todo lo que el profeta Jeremías le había mandado: leyó las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} del rollo en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Baruc hijo de Nerías hizo todo lo que el profeta Jeremías le dijo. Leyó las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} del rollo en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Baruch fils de Nériya fit selon tout ce que lui avait commandé Jérémie le prophète, lisant dans le rouleau les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Baruch fils de Nériya fit tout ce que le prophète Jérémie lui avait commandé : il lut les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans le rouleau, dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Baruch fils de Nériya a fait tout ce que le prophète Jérémie lui avait dit de faire. Il a lu les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans le rouleau, au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye Baruku mwana wa Neria akafanya sawasawa na yote aliyomwagiza Yeremia nabii, akisoma katika kitabu maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Baruku mwana wa Neria alifanya kila kitu ambacho nabii Yeremia alimwagiza: aliyasoma maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka katika gombo ndani ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Baruku mwana wa Neria alifanya kila kitu ambacho nabii Yeremia alimwambia afanye. Aliyasoma maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka katika gombo ndani ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia làm đúng mọi điều nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi đã truyền cho ông, đọc trong cuộn sách những lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia làm đúng mọi điều nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi đã dặn: ông đọc những lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong cuộn sách tại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia làm mọi điều nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi bảo ông. Ông đọc những lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong cuộn sách tại đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 네리야의 아들 바룩은 예언자 예레미야가 자기에게 명령한 모든 것대로 행하여, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 두루마리에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 읽었다.
ko.B: 네리야의 아들 바룩은 예언자 예레미야가 명령한 대로 다 하여, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 두루마리에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 읽었다.
ko.R: 네리야의 아들 바룩은 예언자 예레미야가 하라고 한 대로 다 했다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 두루마리에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 읽었다.

decisions.choice: a summary: verses 9-10 tell in full what this verse tells in brief
decisions.reason: The verse sums up Baruch's obedience; the next verses give the date and the place of the reading, about a year after the writing (verses 1, 9).

decisions.choice: the book: the scroll Baruch had written
decisions.reason: The word for "book" means any written document; here and in verses 10-11 it is the scroll of verse 2.

decisions.choice: scroll
decisions.reason: "Book" would make a modern reader think of bound pages. Every level says "scroll" for this word wherever it means the roll Baruch wrote.

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י בַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַ֠חֲמִשִׁית לִיהוֹיָקִ֨ים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁעִ֔י קָרְא֨וּ צ֜וֹם לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה כָּל־הָעָ֖ם בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְכָל־הָעָ֗ם הַבָּאִ֛ים מֵעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in the year the fifth of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the month the ninth, they proclaimed [a] fast before Yahweh, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people the coming from [the] cities of Judah into Jerusalem.

en.L: And it was in the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, [that] they proclaimed a fast before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah into Jerusalem.
en.B: In the ninth month of the fifth year of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, a fast was proclaimed before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for all the people in Jerusalem and for all the people who came into Jerusalem from the towns of Judah.
en.R: In the ninth month of the fifth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, a fast to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was announced. It was for all the people in Jerusalem, and for all who came into Jerusalem from the towns of Judah.

es.L: Y sucedió en el año quinto de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, en el mes noveno, [que] proclamaron ayuno delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} todo el pueblo en Jerusalén y todo el pueblo que venía de las ciudades de Judá a Jerusalén.
es.B: En el mes noveno del quinto año del reinado de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, se proclamó un ayuno delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para todo el pueblo de Jerusalén y para todos los que llegaban a Jerusalén desde los pueblos de Judá.
es.R: En el mes noveno del quinto año del reinado de Joacim hijo de Josías en Judá, se anunció un ayuno en honor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Era para todo el pueblo de Jerusalén y para todos los que llegaban a Jerusalén desde los pueblos de Judá.

fr.L: Et il arriva en la cinquième année de Joïaqim fils de Josias, roi de Juda, au neuvième mois, [qu’]on proclama un jeûne devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tout le peuple à Jérusalem et tout le peuple qui venait des villes de Juda à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Le neuvième mois de la cinquième année du règne de Joïaqim fils de Josias, roi de Juda, on proclama un jeûne devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour tout le peuple de Jérusalem et pour tous ceux qui venaient à Jérusalem des villes de Juda.
fr.R: Le neuvième mois de la cinquième année où Joïaqim fils de Josias était roi de Juda, on a annoncé un jeûne en l’honneur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il concernait tout le peuple de Jérusalem et tous ceux qui venaient à Jérusalem depuis les villes de Juda.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwaka wa tano wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda, katika mwezi wa tisa, wakatangaza saumu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu wote katika Yerusalemu na watu wote waliokuja kutoka miji ya Yuda mpaka Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Katika mwezi wa tisa wa mwaka wa tano wa utawala wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda, saumu ilitangazwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa watu wote wa Yerusalemu na kwa watu wote waliokuja Yerusalemu kutoka miji ya Yuda.
sw.R: Katika mwezi wa tisa wa mwaka wa tano wa utawala wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda, saumu kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ilitangazwa. Ilikuwa kwa ajili ya watu wote wa Yerusalemu, na kwa wote waliokuja Yerusalemu kutoka miji ya Yuda.

vi.L: Xảy ra vào năm thứ năm đời Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa, vào tháng thứ chín, người ta công bố một kỳ kiêng ăn trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho cả dân ở Giê-ru-sa-lem và cả dân từ các thành Giu-đa đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Vào tháng thứ chín năm thứ năm đời trị vì của Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa, người ta công bố một kỳ kiêng ăn trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho cả dân ở Giê-ru-sa-lem và cả dân từ các thành Giu-đa đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Vào tháng thứ chín năm thứ năm đời Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a làm vua Giu-đa, người ta loan báo một kỳ kiêng ăn để cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Kỳ kiêng ăn ấy dành cho mọi người ở Giê-ru-sa-lem và mọi người từ các thành Giu-đa đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 유다 왕 요시야의 아들 여호야김의 제5년 아홉째 달에, 예루살렘에 있는 모든 백성과 유다의 성읍들에서 예루살렘으로 들어온 모든 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 금식을 선포했다.
ko.B: 요시야의 아들 여호야김이 유다를 다스린 지 5년째 되는 해 아홉째 달에, 예루살렘에 있는 모든 백성과 유다의 성읍들에서 예루살렘으로 들어온 모든 백성에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 금식하라는 선포가 내려졌다.
ko.R: 요시야의 아들 여호야김이 유다의 왕이 된 지 5년째 되는 해 아홉째 달에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드리는 금식이 선포되었다. 그것은 예루살렘에 있는 모든 백성과, 유다의 성읍들에서 예루살렘으로 올라온 모든 사람을 위한 것이었다.

decisions.choice: the ninth month of the fifth year: about December 604 BC
decisions.reason: The ninth month (Kislev) falls in November and December, in the cold rainy season (verse 22). The reading took place more than a year after the LORD's command to write (verse 1).

decisions.choice: a fast proclaimed: a day of prayer called in a time of danger
decisions.reason: The text does not say why the fast was called. In that same month Nebuchadrezzar's army captured Ashkelon on the coast of Philistia, as a Babylonian record of his reign tells, and Judah may have feared it was next. Drought is another possible reason (14:1, 12).

decisions.choice: all the people: those for whom the fast was proclaimed
alternatives: all the people proclaimed a fast
decisions.reason: The verb "they proclaimed" has no named subject; the leaders called the fast. "All the people" are most likely the ones it was called for, though the words can also be read as the people themselves proclaiming it. Either way the whole city and its visitors were there.

decisions.choice: a fast ... was proclaimed for all the people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a passive verb, since no subject is named, and say who the fast was for (m3). Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֨א בָר֥וּךְ בַּסֵּ֛פֶר אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּלִשְׁכַּ֡ת גְּמַרְיָהוּ֩ בֶן־שָׁפָ֨ן הַסֹּפֵ֜ר בֶּחָצֵ֣ר הָעֶלְי֗וֹן פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֤עַר בֵּית־יְהוָה֙ הֶֽחָדָ֔שׁ בְּאָזְנֵ֖י כָּל־הָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah [in the] house of Yahweh in [the] chamber of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe in the court the upper, [at the] entrance of [the] gate of [the] house of Yahweh the new, in [the] ears of all the people.

en.L: And Baruch read from the scroll the words of Jeremiah in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in the chamber of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court, at the entrance of the New Gate of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in the ears of all the people.
en.B: Then Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the scroll in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in the hearing of all the people. He read from the chamber of Gemariah son of Shaphan the secretary, in the upper courtyard, at the entrance of the New Gate of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Baruch read Jeremiah's words from the scroll in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple, so that all the people could hear. He read from the room of Gemariah son of Shaphan the royal secretary. This room was in the upper courtyard, near the entrance of the temple's New Gate.

es.L: Y leyó Baruc en el rollo las palabras de Jeremías en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, en la cámara de Gemarías hijo de Safán el escriba, en el atrio de arriba, a la entrada de la puerta Nueva de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, a oídos de todo el pueblo.
es.B: Entonces Baruc leyó del rollo las palabras de Jeremías en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para que las oyera todo el pueblo. Leyó desde la cámara de Gemarías hijo de Safán el secretario, en el atrio superior, a la entrada de la puerta Nueva de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Baruc leyó las palabras de Jeremías del rollo en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para que todo el pueblo las oyera. Leyó desde la sala de Gemarías hijo de Safán, el secretario del rey. Esa sala estaba en el atrio de arriba, cerca de la entrada de la puerta Nueva del templo.

fr.L: Et Baruch lut dans le rouleau les paroles de Jérémie dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, dans la chambre de Guemaria fils de Shaphân le scribe, dans le parvis supérieur, à l’entrée de la porte Neuve de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, aux oreilles de tout le peuple.
fr.B: Alors Baruch lut les paroles de Jérémie dans le rouleau, dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, devant tout le peuple. Il lisait depuis la chambre de Guemaria fils de Shaphân, le secrétaire, dans le parvis supérieur, à l’entrée de la porte Neuve de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Baruch a lu les paroles de Jérémie dans le rouleau, au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour que tout le peuple les entende. Il lisait depuis la salle de Guemaria fils de Shaphân, le secrétaire du roi. Cette salle se trouvait dans la cour supérieure, près de l’entrée de la porte Neuve du temple.

sw.L: Ndipo Baruku akasoma katika kitabu maneno ya Yeremia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika chumba cha Gemaria mwana wa Shafani mwandishi, katika ua wa juu, penye mlango wa Lango Jipya la nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, masikioni mwa watu wote.
sw.B: Kisha Baruku akayasoma maneno ya Yeremia kutoka katika gombo ndani ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu wote wakisikia. Alisoma akiwa katika chumba cha Gemaria mwana wa Shafani katibu, katika ua wa juu, penye mlango wa Lango Jipya la nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Baruku aliyasoma maneno ya Yeremia kutoka katika gombo ndani ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili watu wote wasikie. Alisoma akiwa katika chumba cha Gemaria mwana wa Shafani, katibu wa mfalme. Chumba hicho kilikuwa katika ua wa juu, karibu na mlango wa Lango Jipya la hekalu.

vi.L: Ba-rúc đọc trong cuộn sách những lời của Giê-rê-mi tại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trong phòng của Ghê-ma-ria con trai Sa-phan thư ký, ở sân trên, tại lối vào Cổng Mới của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vào tai cả dân chúng.
vi.B: Rồi Ba-rúc đọc những lời của Giê-rê-mi trong cuộn sách tại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho cả dân chúng nghe. Ông đọc từ phòng của Ghê-ma-ria con trai Sa-phan, thư ký triều đình, ở sân trên, tại lối vào Cổng Mới của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Ba-rúc đọc những lời của Giê-rê-mi trong cuộn sách tại đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để mọi người đều nghe. Ông đọc từ phòng của Ghê-ma-ria con trai Sa-phan, thư ký hoàng gia. Phòng này ở sân trên, gần lối vào Cổng Mới của đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 바룩이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서, 위쪽 뜰, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 새 문 입구에 있는 서기관 사반의 아들 그마랴의 방에서, 온 백성의 귀에 두루마리에 있는 예레미야의 말을 읽었다.
ko.B: 그때에 바룩이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 온 백성이 듣도록 두루마리에 있는 예레미야의 말을 읽었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 새 문 입구, 위쪽 뜰에 있는 서기관 사반의 아들 그마랴의 방에서 읽었다.
ko.R: 바룩은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 모든 백성이 들을 수 있도록 두루마리에 있는 예레미야의 말을 읽었다. 그는 왕의 서기관인 사반의 아들 그마랴의 방에서 읽었다. 그 방은 위쪽 뜰, 성전의 새 문 입구 가까이에 있었다.

decisions.choice: the chamber of Gemariah: a room on the temple court used by an official
decisions.reason: Rooms were built around the temple courts for priests, Levites and officials (35:4; 1 Chronicles 9:26). Reading from a doorway or window of such a room, Baruch could be heard by the crowd in the court.

decisions.choice: Gemariah son of Shaphan: son of King Josiah's secretary, and brother of Ahikam
decisions.reason: Shaphan was the royal secretary under Josiah who read him the book of the law (2 Kings 22:3-10). His son Ahikam had protected Jeremiah (26:24), and his family stands by the prophet again here (verses 12, 25). "The secretary" probably names Shaphan's old office, since Elishama is the secretary now (verse 12).

decisions.choice: the upper court, the New Gate: the inner court, higher than the outer, at the gate where Jeremiah was tried
decisions.reason: The inner court of the temple stood on higher ground than the outer one. The officials sat at the entrance of the New Gate to judge Jeremiah after his temple sermon (26:10).

decisions.choice: the words of Jeremiah: the same words called the words of the LORD in verse 8
decisions.reason: The words are the LORD's, given through Jeremiah; the narrator can call them by either name.

decisions.choice: chamber (L, B), room (R); the scribe (L), the secretary (B), the royal secretary (R)
decisions.reason: The royal scribe is named as in 2 Kings 22:3: Literal keeps "scribe" and Balanced and Readable name the office "secretary". Balanced puts the hearers at the end of the first sentence so that the place can be given in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: cámara (L, B), sala (R); el escriba (L), el secretario (B), el secretario del rey (R)
decisions.reason: The scribe as a royal officer is "escriba" at Literal and "secretario" at Balanced and Readable, as published 2 Kings 22:3 for Shaphan.

decisions.choice: "mwandishi" (L), "katibu" (B), "katibu wa mfalme" (R)
decisions.reason: For the royal secretary's office Literal keeps the word for a scribe, and Balanced and Readable use "katibu", the word set for the secretary in Kings; Baruch, a scribe by trade, is "mwandishi" at every level.

decisions.choice: "le scribe" (L), "le secrétaire" (B), "le secrétaire du roi" (R)
decisions.reason: The office of *sofer* as the published French of 2 Kings 22:3 ("Shaphân ... le scribe" / "le secrétaire").

decisions.choice: thư ký (L); thư ký triều đình (B); thư ký hoàng gia (R)
decisions.reason: The royal secretary is "thư ký", as Shaphan is in 2 Kings 22 and 2 Chronicles 34. Baruch, a writer by trade, is "người chép sách" (verse 26).

decisions.choice: "방" for the chamber at every level; "서기관" (L, B), "왕의 서기관" (R) for the scribe
decisions.reason: "서기관" is the Kings tables' word for the royal secretary; Readable adds "왕의" as the English Readable says "royal".

source.text: וַ֠יִּשְׁמַ֗ע מִכָ֨יְהוּ בֶן־גְּמַרְיָ֧הוּ בֶן־שָׁפָ֛ן אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל הַסֵּֽפֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard Micaiah son of Gemariah son of Shaphan all [the] words of Yahweh from upon the book,

en.L: And Micaiah son of Gemariah, son of Shaphan, heard all the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the scroll,
en.B: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, son of Shaphan, heard all the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} read from the scroll,
en.R: Micaiah, the son of Gemariah and grandson of Shaphan, heard all the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that Baruch read from the scroll.

es.L: Y oyó Micaías hijo de Gemarías, hijo de Safán, todas las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [leídas] del rollo,
es.B: Cuando Micaías hijo de Gemarías, hijo de Safán, oyó todas las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} leídas del rollo,
es.R: Micaías, hijo de Gemarías y nieto de Safán, oyó todas las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que Baruc leyó del rollo.

fr.L: Et Michée fils de Guemaria, fils de Shaphân, entendit toutes les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [lues] dans le rouleau,
fr.B: Quand Michée fils de Guemaria, fils de Shaphân, eut entendu toutes les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} lues dans le rouleau,
fr.R: Michée, le fils de Guemaria et petit-fils de Shaphân, a entendu toutes les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que Baruch lisait dans le rouleau.

sw.L: Naye Mikaya mwana wa Gemaria, mwana wa Shafani, akasikia maneno yote ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka katika kitabu,
sw.B: Mikaya mwana wa Gemaria, mwana wa Shafani, aliposikia maneno yote ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yakisomwa kutoka katika gombo,
sw.R: Mikaya, mwana wa Gemaria na mjukuu wa Shafani, aliyasikia maneno yote ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ambayo Baruku aliyasoma kutoka katika gombo.

vi.L: Mi-chê con trai Ghê-ma-ria, con trai Sa-phan, nghe mọi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ cuộn sách,
vi.B: Khi Mi-chê con trai Ghê-ma-ria, con trai Sa-phan, nghe đọc mọi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong cuộn sách,
vi.R: Mi-chê, con trai Ghê-ma-ria và cháu nội Sa-phan, nghe hết mọi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà Ba-rúc đọc từ cuộn sách.

ko.L: 그리고 사반의 아들 그마랴의 아들 미가야가 두루마리에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 말씀을 듣고,
ko.B: 사반의 손자요 그마랴의 아들인 미가야가 두루마리에서 읽어 주는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 말씀을 듣고,
ko.R: 그마랴의 아들이요 사반의 손자인 미가야가 바룩이 두루마리에서 읽은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 말씀을 들었다.

decisions.choice: the sentence goes on into verse 12
decisions.reason: Micaiah's hearing leads straight into what he did next. Literal and Balanced end the verse with a comma.

decisions.choice: Micaiah: Shaphan's grandson, listening in his father's chamber
decisions.reason: Micaiah heard the reading from his father Gemariah's room (verse 10). Gemariah himself was at the palace with the other officials (verse 12).

decisions.choice: read (Balanced); that Baruch read; grandson (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says he heard the words "from upon the scroll". Balanced and Readable say they were read aloud, and Readable explains the family line.

decisions.choice: "Michée"
decisions.reason: The published French form for Micaiah in 2 Kings 22:12 ("Akbor fils de Michée").

decisions.choice: Mi-chê
decisions.reason: Micaiah is "Mi-chê", the published form for this name (2 Chronicles 18).

source.text: וַיֵּ֤רֶד בֵּית־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל־לִשְׁכַּ֣ת הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְהִ֨נֵּה־שָׁ֔ם כָּל־הַשָּׂרִ֖ים יֽוֹשְׁבִ֑ים אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַסֹּפֵ֡ר וּדְלָיָ֣הוּ בֶן־שְׁ֠מַעְיָהוּ וְאֶלְנָתָ֨ן בֶּן־עַכְבּ֜וֹר וּגְמַרְיָ֧הוּ בֶן־שָׁפָ֛ן וְצִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־חֲנַנְיָ֖הוּ וְכָל־הַשָּׂרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and he went down [to the] house of the king, to [the] chamber of the scribe, and look, there all the princes [were] sitting: Elishama the scribe and Delaiah son of Shemaiah and Elnathan son of Achbor and Gemariah son of Shaphan and Zedekiah son of Hananiah and all the princes.

en.L: and he went down to the house of the king, to the chamber of the scribe, and look, all the princes [were] sitting there: Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan son of Achbor, and Gemariah son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
en.B: he went down to the king's palace, to the secretary's chamber. All the officials were sitting there: Elishama the secretary, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Achbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah and all the other officials.
en.R: So he went down to the king's palace, to the royal secretary's room. All the leaders were meeting there: Elishama the royal secretary, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Achbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah and all the other leaders.

es.L: y descendió a la casa del rey, a la cámara del escriba, y he aquí, todos los príncipes [estaban] sentados allí: Elisama el escriba, y Delaía hijo de Semaías, y Elnatán hijo de Acbor, y Gemarías hijo de Safán, y Sedequías hijo de Hananías, y todos los príncipes.
es.B: bajó al palacio del rey, a la cámara del secretario. Allí estaban sentados todos los jefes: Elisama el secretario, Delaía hijo de Semaías, Elnatán hijo de Acbor, Gemarías hijo de Safán, Sedequías hijo de Hananías y todos los demás jefes.
es.R: Entonces bajó al palacio del rey, a la sala del secretario del rey. Todos los dirigentes estaban reunidos allí: Elisama, el secretario del rey, Delaía hijo de Semaías, Elnatán hijo de Acbor, Gemarías hijo de Safán, Sedequías hijo de Hananías y todos los demás dirigentes.

fr.L: et il descendit à la maison du roi, à la chambre du scribe, et voici, tous les princes [y étaient] assis : Élishama le scribe, et Delaya fils de Shemaya, et Elnathan fils d’Akbor, et Guemaria fils de Shaphân, et Sédécias fils de Hanania, et tous les princes.
fr.B: il descendit au palais du roi, à la chambre du secrétaire. Tous les chefs y siégeaient : Élishama le secrétaire, Delaya fils de Shemaya, Elnathan fils d’Akbor, Guemaria fils de Shaphân, Sédécias fils de Hanania et tous les autres chefs.
fr.R: Alors il est descendu au palais du roi, à la salle du secrétaire du roi. Tous les chefs y étaient réunis : Élishama le secrétaire du roi, Delaya fils de Shemaya, Elnathan fils d’Akbor, Guemaria fils de Shaphân, Sédécias fils de Hanania et tous les autres chefs.

sw.L: akashuka mpaka nyumba ya mfalme, mpaka chumba cha mwandishi, na tazama, wakuu wote walikuwa wameketi huko: Elishama mwandishi, na Delaya mwana wa Shemaya, na Elnathani mwana wa Akbori, na Gemaria mwana wa Shafani, na Sedekia mwana wa Hanania, na wakuu wote.
sw.B: alishuka mpaka ikulu ya mfalme, katika chumba cha katibu. Maafisa wote walikuwa wameketi huko: Elishama katibu, Delaya mwana wa Shemaya, Elnathani mwana wa Akbori, Gemaria mwana wa Shafani, Sedekia mwana wa Hanania, na maafisa wengine wote.
sw.R: Basi akashuka mpaka ikulu ya mfalme, katika chumba cha katibu wa mfalme. Viongozi wote walikuwa wamekutana huko: Elishama katibu wa mfalme, Delaya mwana wa Shemaya, Elnathani mwana wa Akbori, Gemaria mwana wa Shafani, Sedekia mwana wa Hanania, na viongozi wengine wote.

vi.L: ông đi xuống cung vua, đến phòng thư ký, và kìa, tất cả các quan trưởng đang ngồi tại đó: Ê-li-sa-ma thư ký, Đê-la-gia con trai Sê-ma-gia, Ên-na-than con trai Ạc-bồ, Ghê-ma-ria con trai Sa-phan, Sê-đê-kia con trai Ha-na-nia, và tất cả các quan trưởng.
vi.B: thì ông đi xuống cung vua, đến phòng thư ký. Tất cả các quan chức đang ngồi tại đó: Ê-li-sa-ma thư ký triều đình, Đê-la-gia con trai Sê-ma-gia, Ên-na-than con trai Ạc-bồ, Ghê-ma-ria con trai Sa-phan, Sê-đê-kia con trai Ha-na-nia và tất cả các quan chức khác.
vi.R: Vậy ông đi xuống cung vua, đến phòng của thư ký hoàng gia. Tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo đang họp tại đó: Ê-li-sa-ma thư ký hoàng gia, Đê-la-gia con trai Sê-ma-gia, Ên-na-than con trai Ạc-bồ, Ghê-ma-ria con trai Sa-phan, Sê-đê-kia con trai Ha-na-nia và tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo khác.

ko.L: 왕의 집 서기관의 방으로 내려갔는데, 보라, 거기에 모든 고관이 앉아 있었다. 곧 서기관 엘리사마와 스마야의 아들 들라야와 악볼의 아들 엘라단과 사반의 아들 그마랴와 하나냐의 아들 시드기야와 모든 고관이었다.
ko.B: 왕궁에 있는 서기관의 방으로 내려갔다. 거기에는 모든 관리가 앉아 있었다. 서기관 엘리사마와 스마야의 아들 들라야와 악볼의 아들 엘라단과 사반의 아들 그마랴와 하나냐의 아들 시드기야와 그 밖의 모든 관리가 있었다.
ko.R: 그래서 그는 왕궁에 있는 왕의 서기관의 방으로 내려갔다. 그곳에는 모든 지도자가 모여 있었다. 왕의 서기관 엘리사마와 스마야의 아들 들라야와 악볼의 아들 엘라단과 사반의 아들 그마랴와 하나냐의 아들 시드기야와 그 밖의 모든 지도자가 있었다.

decisions.choice: went down: from the temple to the palace, which stood lower and to the south
decisions.reason: The palace lay just below the temple on the same ridge, so one went "down" from the temple to the palace and "up" from the palace to the temple (26:10).

decisions.choice: the princes: the king's high officials, who governed under him
decisions.reason: The word names men of rank who held office at court. They are not the king's sons; one of them is a royal secretary (Elishama).

decisions.choice: Elnathan son of Achbor; Zedekiah son of Hananiah
decisions.reason: Elnathan is the official Jehoiakim sent to Egypt to bring back the prophet Uriah (26:22); his father Achbor served Josiah (2 Kings 22:12). Zedekiah son of Hananiah is not King Zedekiah, nor is his father the prophet Hananiah of 28:1.

decisions.choice: look, there: what Micaiah found when he arrived
decisions.reason: The word often translated "behold" turns the reader's eye to what Micaiah saw: the whole council already sitting.

decisions.choice: princes (L); officials (B); leaders (R); other (B, R)
decisions.reason: This is the wording settled for this office. Balanced and Readable add "other", since the named men are among "all the officials".

decisions.choice: príncipes (L), jefes (B), dirigentes (R)
decisions.reason: The wording for *sar* at each level through Jeremiah, as published 2 Chronicles. This Sedequías son of Hananías is an official, not the king.

decisions.choice: các quan trưởng (L); các quan chức (B); các nhà lãnh đạo (R)
decisions.reason: *Sarim* are the king's officials, not princes of the blood; the wording follows the Vietnamese of Kings by level, through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "고관들" (L), "관리들" (B), "지도자들" (R) for *sarim*
decisions.reason: As set at 35:4, following the English levels; "방백" is archaic.

source.text: וַיַּגֵּ֤ד לָהֶם֙ מִכָ֔יְהוּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמֵ֑עַ בִּקְרֹ֥א בָר֛וּךְ בַּסֵּ֖פֶר בְּאָזְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And told them Micaiah all the words that he had heard when read Baruch in the book in [the] ears of the people.

en.L: And Micaiah told them all the words that he had heard when Baruch read from the scroll in the ears of the people.
en.B: Micaiah reported to them all the words he had heard when Baruch read from the scroll in the hearing of the people.
en.R: Micaiah told them everything he had heard Baruch read from the scroll to the people.

es.L: Y Micaías les contó todas las palabras que había oído cuando Baruc leyó en el rollo a oídos del pueblo.
es.B: Micaías les informó de todas las palabras que había oído cuando Baruc leyó del rollo para que el pueblo lo oyera.
es.R: Micaías les contó todo lo que había oído leer a Baruc del rollo delante del pueblo.

fr.L: Et Michée leur rapporta toutes les paroles qu’il avait entendues quand Baruch lisait dans le rouleau aux oreilles du peuple.
fr.B: Michée leur rapporta toutes les paroles qu’il avait entendues pendant que Baruch lisait le rouleau devant le peuple.
fr.R: Michée leur a raconté tout ce qu’il avait entendu Baruch lire au peuple dans le rouleau.

sw.L: Naye Mikaya akawaambia maneno yote aliyoyasikia Baruku aliposoma katika kitabu masikioni mwa watu.
sw.B: Mikaya aliwaeleza maneno yote aliyoyasikia wakati Baruku aliposoma kutoka katika gombo mbele ya watu.
sw.R: Mikaya aliwaambia yote aliyoyasikia Baruku akiwasomea watu kutoka katika gombo.

vi.L: Mi-chê thuật cho họ mọi lời ông đã nghe khi Ba-rúc đọc trong cuộn sách vào tai dân chúng.
vi.B: Mi-chê báo cho họ mọi lời ông đã nghe khi Ba-rúc đọc cuộn sách cho dân chúng nghe.
vi.R: Mi-chê kể cho họ nghe mọi điều ông đã nghe Ba-rúc đọc từ cuộn sách cho dân chúng.

ko.L: 그리고 미가야가 바룩이 백성의 귀에 두루마리를 읽을 때 자기가 들은 모든 말을 그들에게 알렸다.
ko.B: 미가야는 바룩이 백성에게 두루마리를 읽어 줄 때 들은 모든 말을 그들에게 보고했다.
ko.R: 미가야는 바룩이 백성에게 두루마리에서 읽어 준 것을 모두 그들에게 전했다.

decisions.choice: told: reported, as a formal report to officials
decisions.reason: The verb is used for bringing news or a report to someone in authority (verses 16, 20). Micaiah tells the officials what was said in public.

decisions.choice: everything he had heard Baruch read ... to the people
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that Baruch read to the people, for "in the ears of the people".

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלְח֨וּ כָל־הַשָּׂרִ֜ים אֶל־בָּר֗וּךְ אֶת־יְהוּדִ֡י בֶּן־נְ֠תַנְיָהוּ בֶּן־שֶׁלֶמְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־כּוּשִׁי֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הַמְּגִלָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤אתָ בָּהּ֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם קָחֶ֥נָּה בְיָדְךָ֖ וָלֵ֑ךְ וַ֠יִּקַּח בָּר֨וּךְ בֶּן־נֵרִיָּ֤הוּ אֶת־הַמְּגִלָּה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֖א אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent all the princes to Baruch Jehudi son of Nethaniah son of Shelemiah son of Cushi, saying, The scroll which you read in it in [the] ears of the people, take it in your hand and come. And took Baruch son of Neriah the scroll in his hand and came to them.

en.L: And all the princes sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah, son of Shelemiah, son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, "The scroll from which you read in the ears of the people, take it in your hand and come." And Baruch son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand and came to them.
en.B: Then all the officials sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah, son of Shelemiah, son of Cushi, to Baruch to say, "Bring the scroll you read to the people, and come." So Baruch son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand and went to them.
en.R: Then all the leaders sent a man named Jehudi to Baruch. Jehudi was the son of Nethaniah, the grandson of Shelemiah and the great-grandson of Cushi. He told Baruch, "Bring the scroll that you read to the people, and come with me." So Baruch son of Neriah took the scroll and went to the leaders.

es.L: Y todos los príncipes enviaron a Baruc a Jehudí hijo de Netanías, hijo de Selemías, hijo de Cusí, diciendo: «El rollo en que leíste a oídos del pueblo, tómalo en tu mano y ven». Y Baruc hijo de Nerías tomó el rollo en su mano y vino a ellos.
es.B: Entonces todos los jefes enviaron a Jehudí hijo de Netanías, hijo de Selemías, hijo de Cusí, para que le dijera a Baruc: «Trae el rollo que leíste al pueblo y ven». Así que Baruc hijo de Nerías tomó el rollo en la mano y fue a verlos.
es.R: Entonces todos los dirigentes enviaron a un hombre llamado Jehudí a buscar a Baruc. Jehudí era hijo de Netanías, nieto de Selemías y bisnieto de Cusí. Le dijo a Baruc: «Trae el rollo que le leíste al pueblo y ven conmigo». Así que Baruc hijo de Nerías tomó el rollo y fue a ver a los dirigentes.

fr.L: Et tous les princes envoyèrent Yehoudi fils de Netania, fils de Shélémia, fils de Koushi, vers Baruch, disant : « Le rouleau dans lequel tu as lu aux oreilles du peuple, prends-le dans ta main et viens. » Et Baruch fils de Nériya prit le rouleau dans sa main et vint vers eux.
fr.B: Alors tous les chefs envoyèrent Yehoudi fils de Netania, fils de Shélémia, fils de Koushi, dire à Baruch : « Apporte le rouleau que tu as lu devant le peuple, et viens. » Baruch fils de Nériya prit donc le rouleau en main et se rendit auprès d’eux.
fr.R: Alors tous les chefs ont envoyé vers Baruch un homme appelé Yehoudi. C’était le fils de Netania, le petit-fils de Shélémia et l’arrière-petit-fils de Koushi. Il a dit à Baruch : « Apporte le rouleau que tu as lu au peuple, et viens avec moi. » Baruch fils de Nériya a donc pris le rouleau et il est allé trouver les chefs.

sw.L: Ndipo wakuu wote wakamtuma Yehudi mwana wa Nethania, mwana wa Shelemia, mwana wa Kushi, kwa Baruku, kusema, "Gombo lile ulilosoma ndani yake masikioni mwa watu, lichukue mkononi mwako, uje." Basi Baruku mwana wa Neria akalichukua gombo mkononi mwake, akaja kwao.
sw.B: Kisha maafisa wote wakamtuma Yehudi mwana wa Nethania, mwana wa Shelemia, mwana wa Kushi, kwa Baruku kumwambia, "Lilete gombo ulilowasomea watu, uje." Basi Baruku mwana wa Neria akalichukua gombo mkononi mwake, akaenda kwao.
sw.R: Kisha viongozi wote wakamtuma mtu mmoja aitwaye Yehudi kwa Baruku. Yehudi alikuwa mwana wa Nethania, mjukuu wa Shelemia na kitukuu wa Kushi. Akamwambia Baruku, "Lilete gombo ulilowasomea watu, uje pamoja nami." Basi Baruku mwana wa Neria akalichukua gombo, akaenda kwa viongozi.

vi.L: Tất cả các quan trưởng sai Giê-hu-đi con trai Nê-tha-nia, con trai Sê-lê-mia, con trai Cút-si, đến với Ba-rúc mà nói: "Cuộn sách ông đã đọc vào tai dân chúng, hãy cầm nó trong tay mà đến." Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia cầm cuộn sách trong tay và đến với họ.
vi.B: Bấy giờ tất cả các quan chức sai Giê-hu-đi con trai Nê-tha-nia, con trai Sê-lê-mia, con trai Cút-si, đến bảo Ba-rúc: "Hãy mang theo cuộn sách ông đã đọc cho dân chúng nghe mà đến đây." Vậy Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia cầm cuộn sách trong tay và đến với họ.
vi.R: Bấy giờ tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo sai một người tên là Giê-hu-đi đến gặp Ba-rúc. Giê-hu-đi là con trai Nê-tha-nia, cháu nội Sê-lê-mia và chắt của Cút-si. Ông nói với Ba-rúc: "Hãy mang cuộn sách ông đã đọc cho dân chúng và đi với tôi." Vậy Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia cầm cuộn sách và đến gặp các nhà lãnh đạo.

ko.L: 그러자 모든 고관이 구시의 증손이요 셀레먀의 손자요 느다냐의 아들인 여후디를 바룩에게 보내어 말했다. "당신이 백성의 귀에 읽은 그 두루마리를 손에 들고 오시오." 그래서 네리야의 아들 바룩이 두루마리를 손에 들고 그들에게 왔다.
ko.B: 그러자 모든 관리가 구시의 증손이요 셀레먀의 손자요 느다냐의 아들인 여후디를 바룩에게 보내어 이렇게 전했다. "당신이 백성에게 읽어 준 그 두루마리를 가지고 오시오." 그래서 네리야의 아들 바룩이 두루마리를 손에 들고 그들에게 갔다.
ko.R: 그러자 지도자들이 여후디라는 사람을 바룩에게 보냈다. 여후디는 느다냐의 아들이며 셀레먀의 손자이고 구시의 증손이었다. 여후디가 바룩에게 말했다. "백성에게 읽어 준 그 두루마리를 가지고 나와 함께 갑시다." 그래서 네리야의 아들 바룩은 두루마리를 들고 지도자들에게 갔다.

decisions.choice: Jehudi son of Nethaniah, son of Shelemiah, son of Cushi: a court messenger named with three generations
decisions.reason: It is unusual to name a man's great-grandfather; it may show that Jehudi came of a known family. His name means "a Judean". Cushi is a personal name here (Zephaniah 1:1), though it can mean "a Cushite".

decisions.choice: the scroll ... take it: the scroll stands first, the thing the officials want
decisions.reason: The officials' order begins with "the scroll" and then picks it up again with "take it". They want the written words themselves, not only Micaiah's report of them.

decisions.choice: a man named; the grandson ... great-grandson; with me
decisions.reason: Readable gives the family line in a sentence of its own and says who came with whom.

decisions.choice: went to them
decisions.reason: Hebrew says Baruch "came" to the officials, from their point of view; English says he "went".

decisions.choice: ông (the officials and their messenger to Baruch); tôi (Baruch)
decisions.reason: The king's officials speak to Baruch, a scribe of a known family, with the polite "ông".

decisions.choice: "구시의 증손이요 셀레먀의 손자요 느다냐의 아들인 여후디"
alternatives: "느다냐의 아들 셀레먀의 아들 구시의 아들 여후디"
decisions.reason: A Korean chain of "X의 아들" reads from the far ancestor down, so a three-generation name is clearer told as great-grandson, grandson and son; the persons are the same.

decisions.choice: The officials and Baruch speak to each other in 하오체 ("오시오", "앉으시오"); Baruch answers them in 합쇼체 (verse 18)
decisions.reason: Royal officials speaking to a scribe they respect; the register used between grown men in the Kings drafts.

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו שֵׁ֣ב נָ֔א וּקְרָאֶ֖נָּה בְּאָזְנֵ֑ינוּ וַיִּקְרָ֥א בָר֖וּךְ בְּאָזְנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said to him, Sit please and read it in our ears. And read Baruch in their ears.

en.L: And they said to him, "Sit down, please, and read it in our ears." And Baruch read [it] in their ears.
en.B: They said to him, "Please sit down and read it to us." So Baruch read it to them.
en.R: "Please sit down," they told him, "and read it to us." So Baruch read it to them.

es.L: Y le dijeron: «Siéntate, por favor, y léelo a nuestros oídos». Y Baruc [lo] leyó a sus oídos.
es.B: Le dijeron: «Por favor, siéntate y léenoslo». Y Baruc se lo leyó.
es.R: «Siéntate, por favor», le dijeron, «y léenoslo». Y Baruc se lo leyó.

fr.L: Et ils lui dirent : « Assieds-toi donc, et lis-le à nos oreilles. » Et Baruch [le] lut à leurs oreilles.
fr.B: Ils lui dirent : « Assieds-toi, s’il te plaît, et lis-le-nous. » Et Baruch le leur lut.
fr.R: « Assieds-toi, s’il te plaît, lui ont-ils dit, et lis-le-nous. » Alors Baruch le leur a lu.

sw.L: Wakamwambia, "Keti tafadhali, ulisome masikioni mwetu." Naye Baruku akalisoma masikioni mwao.
sw.B: Wakamwambia, "Tafadhali keti, utusomee." Basi Baruku akawasomea.
sw.R: Wakamwambia, "Tafadhali keti, utusomee." Basi Baruku akawasomea.

vi.L: Họ nói với ông: "Xin hãy ngồi xuống và đọc nó vào tai chúng tôi." Và Ba-rúc đọc [nó] vào tai họ.
vi.B: Họ nói với ông: "Xin ông ngồi xuống và đọc cho chúng tôi nghe." Vậy Ba-rúc đọc cho họ nghe.
vi.R: Họ bảo ông: "Xin ông ngồi xuống và đọc cho chúng tôi nghe." Vậy Ba-rúc đọc cho họ nghe.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그에게 말했다. "자, 앉아서 그것을 우리 귀에 읽으시오." 그래서 바룩이 그들의 귀에 [그것을] 읽었다.
ko.B: 그들이 그에게 말했다. "자, 앉아서 그것을 우리에게 읽어 주시오." 그래서 바룩이 그들에게 그것을 읽어 주었다.
ko.R: 그들이 바룩에게 말했다. "어서 앉아서 그것을 우리에게 읽어 주시오." 그래서 바룩은 그들에게 그것을 읽어 주었다.

decisions.choice: sit down, please: a courteous welcome
decisions.reason: The officials receive Baruch with respect and ask him to sit, as one sat to read or teach. The king will treat the scroll very differently (verses 23-24).

decisions.choice: in our ears: aloud to us
decisions.reason: As in verse 6.

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י כְּשָׁמְעָם֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים פָּחֲד֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־בָּר֔וּךְ הַגֵּ֤יד נַגִּיד֙ לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when they heard all the words, they turned in dread each to his neighbor, and they said to Baruch, To tell we will tell the king all the words these.

en.L: And it was, when they heard all the words, [that] they turned in dread, each to his neighbor, and they said to Baruch, "We will surely tell the king all these words."
en.B: When they heard all the words, they turned to one another in alarm and said to Baruch, "We must certainly report all these words to the king."
en.R: When they heard all the words, they looked at one another in fear. They said to Baruch, "We must tell the king everything that is written here."

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando oyeron todas las palabras, se volvieron con temor el uno al otro, y dijeron a Baruc: «Ciertamente contaremos al rey todas estas palabras».
es.B: Cuando oyeron todas las palabras, se miraron unos a otros alarmados y le dijeron a Baruc: «Sin duda tenemos que informar al rey de todas estas palabras».
es.R: Cuando oyeron todas las palabras, se miraron unos a otros con miedo. Le dijeron a Baruc: «Tenemos que contarle al rey todo lo que está escrito aquí».

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand ils entendirent toutes les paroles, [qu’]ils se tournèrent avec effroi l’un vers l’autre, et ils dirent à Baruch : « Nous devons rapporter au roi toutes ces paroles. »
fr.B: Quand ils entendirent toutes ces paroles, ils se tournèrent l’un vers l’autre, effrayés, et dirent à Baruch : « Il faut absolument que nous rapportions toutes ces paroles au roi. »
fr.R: Quand ils ont entendu toutes ces paroles, ils se sont regardés les uns les autres avec crainte. Ils ont dit à Baruch : « Nous devons rapporter au roi tout ce qui est écrit là. »

sw.L: Ikawa waliposikia maneno yote, wakageukiana kwa hofu, kila mtu na mwenzake, wakamwambia Baruku, "Hakika tutamweleza mfalme maneno haya yote."
sw.B: Waliposikia maneno yote, wakatazamana kwa hofu, wakamwambia Baruku, "Ni lazima tumweleze mfalme maneno haya yote."
sw.R: Waliposikia maneno yote, walitazamana kwa hofu. Wakamwambia Baruku, "Ni lazima tumwambie mfalme yote yaliyoandikwa humu."

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi họ nghe tất cả các lời ấy, họ sợ hãi quay sang nhau, và họ nói với Ba-rúc: "Chúng tôi nhất định phải tâu với vua mọi lời này."
vi.B: Khi nghe hết các lời ấy, họ hoảng sợ quay sang nhìn nhau và nói với Ba-rúc: "Chúng tôi chắc chắn phải tâu lên vua mọi lời này."
vi.R: Khi nghe hết các lời ấy, họ sợ hãi nhìn nhau. Họ nói với Ba-rúc: "Chúng tôi phải tâu với vua mọi điều đã chép ở đây."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 모든 말을 들었을 때, 그들이 두려워하며 서로를 돌아보았다. 그리고 그들이 바룩에게 말했다. "우리가 이 모든 말을 반드시 왕께 알려야겠소."
ko.B: 그들은 그 모든 말을 듣고 나서 두려워하며 서로 쳐다보았다. 그리고 바룩에게 말했다. "우리는 이 모든 말을 반드시 왕께 보고해야겠소."
ko.R: 그들은 그 모든 말을 듣고 두려워서 서로 쳐다보았다. 그들이 바룩에게 말했다. "여기 적힌 것을 모두 왕께 말씀드려야겠소."

decisions.choice: they were in dread, each to his neighbor: they turned to one another in fear
decisions.reason: The verb of fear is joined to "each to his neighbor", picturing the men turning to look at one another in alarm (compare Genesis 42:28).

decisions.choice: we will surely tell: the officials are bound to report this to the king
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for force. The officials do not threaten Baruch; they see that words like these must reach the king, and they take care to protect Baruch and Jeremiah first (verse 19).

decisions.choice: they were afraid: the officials fear, but the king and his servants do not
decisions.reason: The same verb comes back in verse 24: "they were not afraid". The story sets the officials' fear against the king's lack of it.

decisions.choice: everything that is written here
