decisions.reason: Readable says what "all these words" are: the words on the scroll.

source.text: וְאֶ֨ת־בָּר֔וּךְ שָׁאֲל֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר הַגֶּד־נָ֣א לָ֔נוּ אֵ֗יךְ כָּתַ֛בְתָּ אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִפִּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And Baruch they asked, saying, Tell please to us, how did you write all the words these from his mouth?

en.L: And they asked Baruch, saying, "Tell us, please, how did you write all these words from his mouth?"
en.B: Then they asked Baruch, "Tell us, please, how did you come to write all these words? Was it at his dictation?"
en.R: Then they asked Baruch, "Please tell us how you wrote all this. Did Jeremiah tell you what to write?"

es.L: Y a Baruc le preguntaron, diciendo: «Dinos, por favor, ¿cómo escribiste todas estas palabras de su boca?».
es.B: Luego le preguntaron a Baruc: «Dinos, por favor, ¿cómo llegaste a escribir todas estas palabras? ¿Te las dictó él?».
es.R: Después le preguntaron a Baruc: «Por favor, dinos cómo escribiste todo esto. ¿Te dijo Jeremías lo que tenías que escribir?».

fr.L: Et ils interrogèrent Baruch, disant : « Raconte-nous donc : comment as-tu écrit toutes ces paroles de sa bouche ? »
fr.B: Puis ils demandèrent à Baruch : « Dis-nous, s’il te plaît, comment tu en es venu à écrire toutes ces paroles. Était-ce sous sa dictée ? »
fr.R: Puis ils ont demandé à Baruch : « Dis-nous, s’il te plaît, comment tu as écrit tout cela. Est-ce Jérémie qui t’a dit ce qu’il fallait écrire ? »

sw.L: Wakamwuliza Baruku, kusema, "Tafadhali tuambie, uliandikaje maneno haya yote kutoka kinywani mwake?"
sw.B: Kisha wakamwuliza Baruku, "Tafadhali tuambie, uliandikaje maneno haya yote? Je, alikuwa akikusomea?"
sw.R: Kisha wakamwuliza Baruku, "Tafadhali tuambie jinsi ulivyoandika haya yote. Je, Yeremia alikuambia uandike nini?"

vi.L: Họ hỏi Ba-rúc rằng: "Xin hãy cho chúng tôi biết, ông đã chép mọi lời này từ miệng ông ấy thế nào?"
vi.B: Rồi họ hỏi Ba-rúc: "Xin cho chúng tôi biết, ông đã chép mọi lời này thế nào? Có phải ông ấy đọc cho ông chép không?"
vi.R: Rồi họ hỏi Ba-rúc: "Xin cho chúng tôi biết ông đã chép những điều này thế nào. Có phải Giê-rê-mi bảo ông chép không?"

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 바룩에게 물어 말했다. "자, 우리에게 말해 보시오. 당신이 이 모든 말을 어떻게 그의 입에서 받아 기록했소?"
ko.B: 그리고 그들이 바룩에게 물었다. "자, 우리에게 말해 보시오. 당신이 이 모든 말을 어떻게 기록하게 되었소? 그가 불러 준 것이오?"
ko.R: 그리고 그들이 바룩에게 물었다. "이 모든 것을 어떻게 적었는지 말해 주시오. 예레미야가 무엇을 적으라고 불러 준 것이오?"

decisions.choice: how did you write ... from his mouth: they ask how the scroll was made and whether the words came from Jeremiah himself
alternatives: how did you write all these words that came from his mouth?
decisions.reason: "From his mouth" stands at the end of the question. The officials want to know whose words these are before they report them to the king. Baruch's answer in verse 18 picks up the same words.

decisions.choice: his: Jeremiah's, though he is not named
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's name has not been spoken in the scene, but everyone knows whose prophecy it is.

decisions.choice: a second question: Was it at his dictation? (B); Did Jeremiah tell you what to write? (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make "from his mouth" a question of its own, as the order of the Hebrew suggests (m1); Literal keeps one question. Readable names Jeremiah (m2).

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ בָּר֔וּךְ מִפִּיו֙ יִקְרָ֣א אֵלַ֔י אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַאֲנִ֛י כֹּתֵ֥ב עַל־הַסֵּ֖פֶר בַּדְּיֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And said to them Baruch, From his mouth he would call out to me all the words these, and I [was] writing on the book with ink.

en.L: And Baruch said to them, "From his mouth he would call out to me all these words, and I [was] writing [them] on the scroll with ink."
en.B: Baruch answered them, "He spoke all these words aloud to me, and I wrote them down in ink on the scroll."
en.R: Baruch answered, "Jeremiah said all these words to me out loud, and I wrote them down with ink on the scroll."

es.L: Y Baruc les dijo: «De su boca me dictaba todas estas palabras, y yo [las] escribía en el rollo con tinta».
es.B: Baruc les respondió: «Él me decía en voz alta todas estas palabras, y yo las escribía con tinta en el rollo».
es.R: Baruc respondió: «Jeremías me decía todas estas palabras en voz alta, y yo las escribía con tinta en el rollo».

fr.L: Et Baruch leur dit : « De sa bouche il me dictait toutes ces paroles, et moi j’écrivais sur le rouleau avec de l’encre. »
fr.B: Baruch leur répondit : « Il me dictait à haute voix toutes ces paroles, et je les écrivais à l’encre sur le rouleau. »
fr.R: Baruch a répondu : « Jérémie me disait toutes ces paroles à voix haute, et moi, je les écrivais à l’encre sur le rouleau. »

sw.L: Naye Baruku akawaambia, "Kwa kinywa chake alikuwa akinitajia maneno haya yote, nami nilikuwa nikiyaandika katika kitabu kwa wino."
sw.B: Baruku akawajibu, "Alinitamkia maneno haya yote kwa sauti, nami nikayaandika kwa wino katika gombo."
sw.R: Baruku akajibu, "Yeremia aliniambia maneno haya yote kwa sauti, nami nikayaandika kwa wino katika gombo."

vi.L: Ba-rúc nói với họ: "Từ miệng mình ông ấy đọc to cho tôi mọi lời này, và tôi viết [chúng] bằng mực vào cuộn sách."
vi.B: Ba-rúc đáp: "Ông ấy nói to mọi lời này cho tôi, và tôi lấy mực chép vào cuộn sách."
vi.R: Ba-rúc trả lời: "Giê-rê-mi nói to mọi lời này cho tôi, và tôi lấy mực chép vào cuộn sách."

ko.L: 그러자 바룩이 그들에게 말했다. "그가 자기 입으로 이 모든 말을 나에게 불러 주었고, 나는 먹으로 두루마리에 [그것을] 기록하고 있었습니다."
ko.B: 바룩이 그들에게 대답했다. "그분이 이 모든 말을 소리 내어 불러 주셨고, 저는 그것을 먹으로 두루마리에 받아 적었습니다."
ko.R: 바룩이 대답했다. "예레미야 선생님께서 이 모든 말을 소리 내어 불러 주셨고, 저는 그것을 먹으로 두루마리에 받아 적었습니다."

decisions.choice: he would call out ... I was writing: a long process, word after word
decisions.reason: The verb forms picture an action going on over time: Jeremiah kept reciting, and Baruch kept writing.

decisions.choice: ink: the word occurs only here in the Hebrew Bible
decisions.reason: Ink was made from soot or charcoal mixed with gum and water, and written with a reed pen on leather or papyrus. Baruch's plain answer insists that he added nothing of his own.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah
decisions.reason: Readable names Jeremiah for "he", as in verse 17.

decisions.choice: Baruch speaks of Jeremiah with "-시-" at Balanced and Readable ("불러 주셨고"), and of himself as "저"
decisions.reason: Korean marks Baruch's respect for his master before the officials; Literal keeps the plain pronoun as the Hebrew does.

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ הַשָּׂרִים֙ אֶל־בָּר֔וּךְ לֵ֥ךְ הִסָּתֵ֖ר אַתָּ֣ה וְיִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ אַל־יֵדַ֖ע אֵיפֹ֥ה אַתֶּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the princes to Baruch, Go, hide yourself, you and Jeremiah, and anyone not let know where you [are].

en.L: And the princes said to Baruch, "Go, hide yourself, you and Jeremiah, and let no one know where you [are]."
en.B: Then the officials said to Baruch, "Go and hide, you and Jeremiah. Do not let anyone know where you are."
en.R: Then the leaders told Baruch, "You and Jeremiah must go and hide. Do not let anyone know where you are."

es.L: Y los príncipes dijeron a Baruc: «Ve, escóndete, tú y Jeremías, y que nadie sepa dónde [{{plural_you:están|estáis}}]».
es.B: Entonces los jefes le dijeron a Baruc: «Ve y escóndete, tú y Jeremías. Que nadie sepa dónde {{plural_you:están|estáis}}».
es.R: Entonces los dirigentes le dijeron a Baruc: «Tú y Jeremías {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que ir a esconderse. Que nadie sepa dónde {{plural_you:están|estáis}}».

fr.L: Et les princes dirent à Baruch : « Va, cache-toi, toi et Jérémie, et que personne ne sache où vous [êtes]. »
fr.B: Alors les chefs dirent à Baruch : « Va te cacher, toi et Jérémie. Que personne ne sache où vous êtes. »
fr.R: Alors les chefs ont dit à Baruch : « Toi et Jérémie, allez vous cacher. Que personne ne sache où vous êtes ! »

sw.L: Ndipo wakuu wakamwambia Baruku, "Nenda, ujifiche, wewe na Yeremia, wala mtu asijue mlipo."
sw.B: Kisha maafisa wakamwambia Baruku, "Nenda mkajifiche, wewe na Yeremia. Msimwache mtu yeyote ajue mlipo."
sw.R: Kisha viongozi wakamwambia Baruku, "Wewe na Yeremia nendeni mkajifiche. Msimwache mtu yeyote ajue mlipo."

vi.L: Các quan trưởng nói với Ba-rúc: "Hãy đi trốn, ông và Giê-rê-mi, và đừng để ai biết các ông ở đâu."
vi.B: Bấy giờ các quan chức nói với Ba-rúc: "Ông và Giê-rê-mi hãy đi trốn đi. Đừng để ai biết các ông ở đâu."
vi.R: Rồi các nhà lãnh đạo bảo Ba-rúc: "Ông và Giê-rê-mi phải đi trốn ngay. Đừng để ai biết các ông ở đâu."

ko.L: 그러자 고관들이 바룩에게 말했다. "가서 숨으시오. 당신과 예레미야가. 그리고 아무도 당신들이 어디 [있는지] 알지 못하게 하시오."
ko.B: 그러자 관리들이 바룩에게 말했다. "당신과 예레미야는 가서 숨으시오. 당신들이 어디에 있는지 아무도 모르게 하시오."
ko.R: 그러자 지도자들이 바룩에게 말했다. "당신과 예레미야는 어서 가서 숨으시오. 당신들이 어디에 있는지 아무에게도 알리지 마시오."

decisions.choice: hide: the officials know the king may kill them
decisions.reason: Jehoiakim had already had the prophet Uriah brought back from Egypt and put to death for a message like Jeremiah's (26:20-23).

decisions.choice: the officials fear the words and protect the messengers
decisions.reason: Some of the king's own officials take the warning seriously. Their counsel to hide, and the LORD's hiding in verse 26, keep Baruch and Jeremiah alive.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ אֶל־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ חָצֵ֔רָה וְאֶת־הַמְּגִלָּ֣ה הִפְקִ֔דוּ בְּלִשְׁכַּ֖ת אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַסֹּפֵ֑ר וַיַּגִּ֨ידוּ֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they went to the king [to the] court, and the scroll they had deposited in [the] chamber of Elishama the scribe; and they told in [the] ears of the king all the words.

en.L: And they went in to the king, to the court, but the scroll they had deposited in the chamber of Elishama the scribe; and they told all the words in the ears of the king.
en.B: They went in to the king in the courtyard, having left the scroll for safekeeping in the chamber of Elishama the secretary, and they reported all the words to the king.
en.R: The leaders left the scroll in the room of Elishama the royal secretary, where it would be safe. Then they went in to the king in the courtyard and told him everything it said.

es.L: Y entraron al rey, al atrio, pero el rollo lo habían depositado en la cámara de Elisama el escriba; y contaron a oídos del rey todas las palabras.
es.B: Entraron a ver al rey en el atrio, después de dejar el rollo guardado en la cámara de Elisama el secretario, y le informaron al rey de todas las palabras.
es.R: Los jefes dejaron el rollo en la sala de Elisama, el secretario del rey, donde estaría seguro. Luego entraron a ver al rey en el atrio y le contaron todo lo que decía.

fr.L: Et ils entrèrent chez le roi, dans la cour, mais le rouleau, ils l’avaient déposé dans la chambre d’Élishama le scribe ; et ils dirent toutes les paroles aux oreilles du roi.
fr.B: Ils se rendirent auprès du roi, dans la cour, après avoir laissé le rouleau en dépôt dans la chambre d’Élishama le secrétaire, et ils rapportèrent au roi toutes les paroles.
fr.R: Les chefs ont laissé le rouleau dans la salle d’Élishama, le secrétaire du roi, où il serait en sûreté. Puis ils sont allés trouver le roi dans la cour et lui ont raconté tout ce qu’il contenait.

sw.L: Nao wakaingia kwa mfalme, uani, lakini gombo walikuwa wameliweka katika chumba cha Elishama mwandishi; wakamweleza mfalme maneno yote masikioni mwake.
sw.B: Wakaingia kwa mfalme uani, baada ya kuliweka gombo salama katika chumba cha Elishama katibu, wakamweleza mfalme maneno yote.
sw.R: Viongozi waliliacha gombo katika chumba cha Elishama katibu wa mfalme, mahali ambapo lingekuwa salama. Kisha wakaingia kwa mfalme uani, wakamweleza yote yaliyoandikwa ndani yake.

vi.L: Họ vào chầu vua ở sân trong, còn cuộn sách thì họ đã gửi giữ trong phòng của Ê-li-sa-ma thư ký; và họ thuật lại mọi lời ấy vào tai vua.
vi.B: Họ vào chầu vua ở sân trong, sau khi đã gửi cuộn sách trong phòng của Ê-li-sa-ma, thư ký triều đình, và họ tâu với vua mọi lời ấy.
vi.R: Các nhà lãnh đạo để cuộn sách lại trong phòng của Ê-li-sa-ma, thư ký hoàng gia, cho được an toàn. Rồi họ vào gặp vua ở sân trong và tâu với vua mọi điều đã chép trong đó.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 왕에게로, 뜰로 들어갔다. 그러나 그 두루마리는 서기관 엘리사마의 방에 맡겨 두었다. 그리고 그들이 왕의 귀에 그 모든 말을 알렸다.
ko.B: 그들은 그 두루마리를 서기관 엘리사마의 방에 맡겨 두고, 뜰에 있는 왕에게 들어가서 그 모든 말을 왕에게 보고했다.
ko.R: 지도자들은 두루마리를 안전하게 보관하려고 왕의 서기관 엘리사마의 방에 두었다. 그러고 나서 뜰에 있는 왕에게 들어가서, 그 두루마리에 적힌 것을 모두 말씀드렸다.

decisions.choice: they had deposited: put in someone's keeping for safety
decisions.reason: The verb is used for leaving something in trust (37:21; 40:7). The officials leave the scroll in the secretary's room before going to the king, perhaps to keep it from his hands.

decisions.choice: the court: the palace courtyard, around which the king's rooms stood
decisions.reason: The officials go in through the court to the king, who was sitting in his winter rooms (verse 22).

decisions.choice: the leaving of the scroll told first; where it would be safe
decisions.reason: The Hebrew tells the earlier action second, as an aside. Readable tells events in the order they happened and says why the scroll was left (m1).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־יְהוּדִ֗י לָקַ֨חַת֙ אֶת־הַמְּגִלָּ֔ה וַיִּ֨קָּחֶ֔הָ מִלִּשְׁכַּ֖ת אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַסֹּפֵ֑ר וַיִּקְרָאֶ֤הָ יְהוּדִי֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּבְאָזְנֵי֙ כָּל־הַשָּׂרִ֔ים הָעֹמְדִ֖ים מֵעַ֥ל הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent the king Jehudi to take the scroll, and he took it from [the] chamber of Elishama the scribe; and read it Jehudi in [the] ears of the king and in [the] ears of all the princes the standing from upon the king.

en.L: And the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it from the chamber of Elishama the scribe; and Jehudi read it in the ears of the king and in the ears of all the princes who were standing beside the king.
en.B: The king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he brought it from the chamber of Elishama the secretary. Jehudi read it to the king and to all the officials who stood in attendance on him.
en.R: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and Jehudi brought it from Elishama's room. Then he read it aloud to the king and to all the leaders standing around him.

es.L: Y el rey envió a Jehudí a tomar el rollo, y él lo tomó de la cámara de Elisama el escriba; y Jehudí lo leyó a oídos del rey y a oídos de todos los príncipes que estaban de pie junto al rey.
es.B: El rey envió a Jehudí a buscar el rollo, y él lo trajo de la cámara de Elisama el secretario. Jehudí se lo leyó al rey y a todos los jefes que estaban de pie a su servicio.
es.R: Así que el rey envió a Jehudí a buscar el rollo, y Jehudí lo trajo de la sala de Elisama. Luego se lo leyó en voz alta al rey y a todos los dirigentes que estaban de pie a su alrededor.

fr.L: Et le roi envoya Yehoudi prendre le rouleau, et il le prit dans la chambre d’Élishama le scribe ; et Yehoudi le lut aux oreilles du roi et aux oreilles de tous les princes qui se tenaient auprès du roi.
fr.B: Le roi envoya Yehoudi chercher le rouleau, et celui-ci le rapporta de la chambre d’Élishama le secrétaire. Yehoudi le lut au roi et à tous les chefs qui se tenaient à son service.
fr.R: Le roi a donc envoyé Yehoudi chercher le rouleau, et Yehoudi l’a rapporté de la salle d’Élishama. Puis il l’a lu à haute voix au roi et à tous les chefs qui se tenaient autour de lui.

sw.L: Naye mfalme akamtuma Yehudi kulichukua gombo, naye akalitoa katika chumba cha Elishama mwandishi; Yehudi akalisoma masikioni mwa mfalme na masikioni mwa wakuu wote waliosimama karibu na mfalme.
sw.B: Mfalme akamtuma Yehudi kulileta gombo, naye akalileta kutoka katika chumba cha Elishama katibu. Yehudi akamsomea mfalme na maafisa wote waliokuwa wamesimama kumhudumia.
sw.R: Basi mfalme akamtuma Yehudi kulileta gombo, naye Yehudi akalileta kutoka katika chumba cha Elishama. Kisha akamsomea mfalme kwa sauti, pamoja na viongozi wote waliokuwa wamesimama kumzunguka.

vi.L: Vua sai Giê-hu-đi đi lấy cuộn sách, và ông lấy nó từ phòng của Ê-li-sa-ma thư ký; Giê-hu-đi đọc nó vào tai vua và vào tai tất cả các quan trưởng đang đứng chầu bên vua.
vi.B: Vua sai Giê-hu-đi đi lấy cuộn sách, và ông đem nó về từ phòng của Ê-li-sa-ma, thư ký triều đình. Giê-hu-đi đọc cho vua và tất cả các quan chức đang đứng hầu vua nghe.
vi.R: Vậy vua sai Giê-hu-đi đi lấy cuộn sách, và Giê-hu-đi đem nó về từ phòng của Ê-li-sa-ma. Rồi ông đọc to cho vua và tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo đang đứng quanh vua nghe.

ko.L: 그러자 왕이 여후디를 보내어 그 두루마리를 가져오게 하니, 그가 서기관 엘리사마의 방에서 그것을 가져왔다. 그리고 여후디가 왕의 귀와 왕 곁에 서 있는 모든 고관의 귀에 그것을 읽었다.
ko.B: 왕은 여후디를 보내어 그 두루마리를 가져오게 했고, 여후디는 서기관 엘리사마의 방에서 그것을 가져왔다. 그리고 여후디는 왕과 왕을 모시고 서 있는 모든 관리에게 그것을 읽어 주었다.
ko.R: 그래서 왕은 여후디를 보내어 그 두루마리를 가져오게 했다. 여후디는 엘리사마의 방에서 두루마리를 가져와, 왕과 왕 둘레에 서 있는 모든 지도자에게 소리 내어 읽어 주었다.

decisions.choice: standing from upon the king: standing by the seated king, ready to serve
decisions.reason: Officials stood while the king sat (verse 22); the phrase pictures attendants around a seated master (Genesis 18:8).

decisions.choice: the third reading, each closer to the king
decisions.reason: The words are read to the people (verse 10), to the officials (verse 15), and now to the king himself.

decisions.choice: stood in attendance on him
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the sense of service in the idiom (m1); Literal says "standing beside" and Readable "standing around".

source.text: וְהַמֶּ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב֙ בֵּ֣ית הַחֹ֔רֶף בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֑י וְאֶת־הָאָ֖ח לְפָנָ֥יו מְבֹעָֽרֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And the king [was] sitting [in the] house of the winter in the month the ninth, and the brazier before him [was] burning.

en.L: And the king [was] sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, and the brazier [was] burning before him.
en.B: It was the ninth month, and the king was sitting in his winter house, with a fire burning in the brazier in front of him.
en.R: It was winter, the ninth month of the year. The king was sitting in his winter rooms, and a fire was burning in a fire pot in front of him.

es.L: Y el rey [estaba] sentado en la casa de invierno, en el mes noveno, y el brasero [ardía] delante de él.
es.B: Era el mes noveno, y el rey estaba sentado en su casa de invierno, con un fuego encendido en el brasero delante de él.
es.R: Era invierno, el mes noveno del año. El rey estaba sentado en sus habitaciones de invierno, y delante de él ardía un fuego en un brasero.

fr.L: Et le roi [était] assis dans la maison d’hiver, au neuvième mois, et le brasero [brûlait] devant lui.
fr.B: C’était le neuvième mois, et le roi était assis dans sa maison d’hiver, avec un feu qui brûlait dans le brasero devant lui.
fr.R: C’était l’hiver, le neuvième mois de l’année. Le roi était assis dans ses appartements d’hiver, et un feu brûlait devant lui dans un brasero.

sw.L: Naye mfalme alikuwa ameketi katika nyumba ya majira ya baridi katika mwezi wa tisa, na moto wa jiko ulikuwa ukiwaka mbele yake.
sw.B: Ilikuwa mwezi wa tisa, naye mfalme alikuwa ameketi katika nyumba yake ya majira ya baridi, na moto ulikuwa ukiwaka katika jiko mbele yake.
sw.R: Ilikuwa majira ya baridi, mwezi wa tisa wa mwaka. Mfalme alikuwa ameketi katika vyumba vyake vya majira ya baridi, na moto ulikuwa ukiwaka katika chombo cha moto mbele yake.

vi.L: Vua đang ngồi trong cung mùa đông vào tháng thứ chín, và lò than đang cháy trước mặt vua.
vi.B: Lúc ấy là tháng thứ chín, và vua đang ngồi trong cung mùa đông, có lửa cháy trong lò than trước mặt vua.
vi.R: Lúc ấy là mùa đông, tháng thứ chín trong năm. Vua đang ngồi trong cung mùa đông, và có một lò lửa đang cháy trước mặt vua.

ko.L: 그리고 왕은 아홉째 달에 겨울 집에 앉아 [있었고], 그 앞에는 화로가 타고 [있었다].
ko.B: 때는 아홉째 달이었고, 왕은 겨울 궁전에 앉아 있었으며, 그 앞에는 화로에 불이 타고 있었다.
ko.R: 그때는 겨울, 그해의 아홉째 달이었다. 왕은 겨울에 쓰는 방에 앉아 있었고, 그 앞에 있는 화로에서는 불이 타고 있었다.

decisions.choice: the winter house: rooms of the palace used in the cold season
decisions.reason: Kings had separate quarters, or a separate house, for winter and for summer (Amos 3:15). The ninth month falls in November and December, when Jerusalem is cold and wet.

decisions.choice: the brazier: a pot or pan of coals for heating a room
decisions.reason: The word occurs only in this chapter (verses 22-23). It names a portable fire pot, of metal or clay, set on the floor.

decisions.choice: the brazier ... was burning: the brazier is the subject
decisions.reason: Before "the brazier" stands the small word that usually marks an object, but here the brazier is the subject of "burning". Such a use is found elsewhere in Hebrew, and the sense is clear.

decisions.choice: with a fire burning in the brazier (B); it was winter; a fire pot (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the fire burned in the brazier, which Literal has as "the brazier [was] burning". Readable says "winter" and "fire pot" in everyday words.

decisions.choice: lò than (L, B); lò lửa (R)
decisions.reason: The brazier is a pan of burning coals, "lò than"; "lò sưởi" would suggest a fireplace built into a wall.

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י׀כִּקְר֣וֹא יְהוּדִ֗י שָׁלֹ֣שׁ דְּלָתוֹת֮ וְאַרְבָּעָה֒ יִֽקְרָעֶ֨הָ֙ בְּתַ֣עַר הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְהַשְׁלֵ֕ךְ אֶל־הָאֵ֖שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶל־הָאָ֑ח עַד־תֹּם֙ כָּל־הַמְּגִלָּ֔ה עַל־הָאֵ֖שׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הָאָֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, as read Jehudi three doors and four, he would tear it with [the] knife of the scribe and throw [it] into the fire that [was] in the brazier, until was consumed all the scroll on the fire that [was] on the brazier.

en.L: And it was, as Jehudi read three columns or four, [that] he would tear it with the knife of the scribe and throw [it] into the fire that [was] in the brazier, until the whole scroll was consumed on the fire that [was] in the brazier.
en.B: Whenever Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king would cut them away with a scribe's knife and throw them on the fire in the brazier, until the whole scroll was burned up in the fire.
en.R: Each time Jehudi finished reading three or four columns of the scroll, the king cut them off with a small knife used by scribes and threw them into the fire. He kept doing this until the whole scroll was burned up.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Jehudí leía tres o cuatro columnas, él las rasgaba con el cortaplumas del escriba y [las] echaba en el fuego que [había] en el brasero, hasta que todo el rollo se consumió en el fuego que [había] en el brasero.
es.B: Cada vez que Jehudí terminaba de leer tres o cuatro columnas, el rey las cortaba con un cortaplumas de escriba y las echaba al fuego del brasero, hasta que todo el rollo se quemó en el fuego.
es.R: Cada vez que Jehudí terminaba de leer tres o cuatro columnas del rollo, el rey las cortaba con una navaja pequeña de las que usaban los escribas y las tiraba al fuego. Siguió haciéndolo hasta que todo el rollo se quemó.

fr.L: Et il arriva, chaque fois que Yehoudi avait lu trois colonnes ou quatre, [que] il le déchirait avec le canif du scribe et [le] jetait au feu qui [était] dans le brasero, jusqu’à ce que tout le rouleau fût consumé sur le feu qui [était] dans le brasero.
fr.B: Chaque fois que Yehoudi avait lu trois ou quatre colonnes, le roi les découpait avec un canif de scribe et les jetait au feu du brasero, jusqu’à ce que tout le rouleau soit consumé dans le feu.
fr.R: Chaque fois que Yehoudi finissait de lire trois ou quatre colonnes du rouleau, le roi les découpait avec un petit couteau de scribe et les jetait au feu. Il a fait ainsi jusqu’à ce que tout le rouleau soit brûlé.

sw.L: Ikawa, Yehudi aliposoma safu tatu au nne, alilikata kwa kisu cha mwandishi na kulitupa ndani ya moto uliokuwa katika jiko, mpaka gombo lote likateketea katika moto uliokuwa katika jiko.
sw.B: Kila mara Yehudi aliposoma safu tatu au nne, mfalme alizikata kwa kisu cha mwandishi na kuzitupa motoni katika jiko, mpaka gombo lote likateketea motoni.
sw.R: Kila mara Yehudi alipomaliza kusoma safu tatu au nne za gombo, mfalme alizikata kwa kisu kidogo kinachotumiwa na waandishi, akazitupa motoni. Aliendelea kufanya hivyo mpaka gombo lote likateketea.

vi.L: Xảy ra, cứ khi Giê-hu-đi đọc được ba bốn cột, vua lại cắt nó bằng con dao của thư ký và ném [vào] lửa trong lò than, cho đến khi cả cuộn sách bị thiêu hủy trong lửa trong lò than.
vi.B: Cứ mỗi khi Giê-hu-đi đọc xong ba bốn cột, vua lại lấy dao của thư ký cắt phần ấy ra và ném vào lửa trong lò than, cho đến khi cả cuộn sách bị thiêu rụi trong lửa.
vi.R: Mỗi lần Giê-hu-đi đọc xong ba bốn cột chữ, vua lại lấy con dao nhỏ của người viết sách cắt phần ấy ra và ném vào lửa. Vua cứ làm như thế cho đến khi cả cuộn sách cháy hết.

ko.L: 그리고 여후디가 서너 단을 읽을 때마다, 그가 서기관의 칼로 그것을 찢어 화로에 있는 불에 던지곤 하여, 마침내 그 두루마리 전체가 화로에 있는 불에 다 타 버렸다.
ko.B: 여후디가 서너 단을 읽을 때마다, 왕은 서기관의 칼로 그 부분을 잘라 내어 화로의 불 속에 던졌다. 그렇게 하여 마침내 두루마리 전체가 불에 다 타 버렸다.
ko.R: 여후디가 두루마리를 서너 단씩 읽을 때마다, 왕은 서기관들이 쓰는 작은 칼로 그 부분을 잘라서 불 속에 던졌다. 왕은 두루마리가 모두 타 버릴 때까지 그렇게 했다.

decisions.choice: columns: the panels of writing set side by side along a scroll
decisions.reason: The word usually means "doors". Here it names the columns of text, each like a narrow door-leaf standing beside the next as the scroll is unrolled. Some take it as sheets or pages; the sense is a section of a few columns at a time.

decisions.choice: he would tear it: the king, again and again as the reading went on
decisions.reason: The subject is not named, but verses 25 and 27-29 say that the king burned the scroll. The verbs picture a repeated act: each time a few columns were read, he cut them away.

decisions.choice: tear: the same verb as "tear" their garments in verse 24
decisions.reason: The king tore the scroll, but no one tore his clothes in grief. The play on the word is the point of the scene.

decisions.choice: the knife of the scribe: a small blade for trimming reed pens and cutting scroll material
decisions.reason: A scribe carried a small knife with his pen and ink. The king uses a writer's tool to destroy the writing.

decisions.choice: tear (L); cut them off (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "tear" so that the reader can see the same verb as in verse 24 (m3). Balanced and Readable say "cut off", since a knife was used, and name the king as the one who did it (m2).

decisions.choice: rasgaba (L); cortaba (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "rasgar", the verb used for tearing clothes in verse 24; Balanced and Readable say what the king did with a knife.

decisions.choice: "alilikata" (cut) at every level
decisions.reason: Swahili "kurarua" is tearing by hand, which a knife does not do; "kukata" says what the king did. The link with "tear their garments" in verse 24 is left to the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "il le déchirait", "les découpait" (imparfait)
decisions.reason: The king cut the scroll again and again as the reading went on: the imparfait for the repeated act, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: ba bốn cột (L, B); ba bốn cột chữ (R)
decisions.reason: The "doors" are the columns of writing set side by side on a scroll; Vietnamese "cột" names them, and Readable adds "chữ".

decisions.choice: "단" for the columns of the scroll
decisions.reason: "단" names a column of writing set beside others; "장" and "쪽" suggest the pages of a bound book.

source.text: וְלֹ֣א פָחֲד֔וּ וְלֹ֥א קָרְע֖וּ אֶת־בִּגְדֵיהֶ֑ם הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְכָל־עֲבָדָ֔יו הַשֹּׁ֣מְעִ֔ים אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And not they were afraid and not they tore their garments, the king and all his servants the hearing all the words these.

en.L: And they were not afraid, and they did not tear their garments, the king and all his servants who heard all these words.
en.B: Yet neither the king nor any of his officials who heard all these words was afraid, and they did not tear their clothes.
en.R: The king and all his officials heard all these words, but they were not afraid. They did not tear their clothes to show they were sorry.

es.L: Y no temieron ni rasgaron sus vestidos el rey y todos sus siervos que oyeron todas estas palabras.
es.B: Sin embargo, ni el rey ni ninguno de sus funcionarios que oyeron todas estas palabras tuvieron miedo, ni rasgaron sus vestidos.
es.R: El rey y todos sus funcionarios oyeron todas estas palabras, pero no tuvieron miedo. No rasgaron su ropa para mostrar que estaban arrepentidos.

fr.L: Et ils ne furent pas effrayés, et ils ne déchirèrent pas leurs vêtements, le roi et tous ses serviteurs qui entendirent toutes ces paroles.
fr.B: Pourtant ni le roi ni aucun de ses officiers qui entendirent toutes ces paroles ne furent effrayés, et ils ne déchirèrent pas leurs vêtements.
fr.R: Le roi et tous ses officiers ont entendu toutes ces paroles, mais ils n’ont pas eu peur. Ils n’ont pas déchiré leurs vêtements pour montrer leur regret.

sw.L: Wala hawakuogopa, wala hawakuyararua mavazi yao, mfalme na watumishi wake wote waliosikia maneno haya yote.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, mfalme na maafisa wake wote waliosikia maneno haya yote hawakuogopa, wala hawakuyararua mavazi yao.
sw.R: Mfalme na maafisa wake wote waliyasikia maneno haya yote, lakini hawakuogopa. Hawakuyararua mavazi yao kuonyesha kwamba wanajuta.

vi.L: Nhưng họ không sợ, cũng không xé áo mình, vua và mọi đầy tớ của vua là những người đã nghe tất cả các lời này.
vi.B: Thế mà cả vua lẫn các triều thần của vua đã nghe tất cả các lời này đều không sợ hãi, cũng không xé áo mình.
vi.R: Vua và các triều thần đều nghe hết những lời này, nhưng họ không hề sợ hãi. Họ không xé áo mình để tỏ lòng hối hận.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 두려워하지 않았고 자기 옷을 찢지도 않았다. 이 모든 말을 들은 왕과 그의 모든 신하가 그러했다.
ko.B: 그러나 이 모든 말을 들은 왕도, 그의 신하들 가운데 누구도 두려워하지 않았고, 옷을 찢지도 않았다.
ko.R: 왕과 그의 모든 신하는 이 모든 말을 들었지만 두려워하지 않았다. 그들은 뉘우치는 뜻으로 옷을 찢지도 않았다.

decisions.choice: they did not tear their garments: the opposite of what Josiah, Jehoiakim's father, did
decisions.reason: When Josiah heard the words of the book of the law read by Shaphan the secretary, he tore his clothes and humbled himself (2 Kings 22:11, 19). Now a scroll is read in the presence of Shaphan's son and grandson, and Josiah's son does not tear his clothes but tears the scroll.

decisions.choice: they were not afraid: set against the officials' fear in verse 16
decisions.reason: The same verb is used. The officials who heard the words feared; the king and his servants did not.

decisions.choice: all his servants: the king's courtiers in the room, not the three officials of verse 25
decisions.reason: Verse 25 names officials who pleaded with the king, so "all his servants" here are those of his court who took his side.

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: The king's servants are his court officials, as the wording for Isaiah has it; Literal keeps "servants".

decisions.choice: to show they were sorry
decisions.reason: Readable says what tearing one's clothes meant: grief and repentance (m1).

decisions.choice: rasgaron (all levels)
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 23 at Literal, so that the contrast can be seen: the king tore the scroll, not his clothes.

decisions.choice: các triều thần
decisions.reason: The king's "servants" here are his courtiers in the room; Balanced and Readable say "triều thần". God's servants stay "đầy tớ".

decisions.choice: "신하" for the king's servants at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note gives 종들 (L) and 신하들 (B, R) for court officials; here Literal also says 신하 because the room is the king's own court and "종" would read as household slaves.

source.text: וְגַם֩ אֶלְנָתָ֨ן וּדְלָיָ֤הוּ וּגְמַרְיָ֨הוּ֙ הִפְגִּ֣עוּ בַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְבִלְתִּ֥י שְׂרֹ֖ף אֶת־הַמְּגִלָּ֑ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And even Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, and not he listened to them.

en.L: And even Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, but he did not listen to them.
en.B: Elnathan, Delaiah and Gemariah even pleaded with the king not to burn the scroll, but he refused to listen to them.
en.R: Elnathan, Delaiah and Gemariah even begged the king not to burn the scroll, but he would not listen to them.

es.L: Y aunque Elnatán y Delaía y Gemarías rogaron al rey que no quemara el rollo, no los escuchó.
es.B: Elnatán, Delaía y Gemarías incluso le suplicaron al rey que no quemara el rollo, pero él no quiso escucharlos.
es.R: Elnatán, Delaía y Gemarías hasta le rogaron al rey que no quemara el rollo, pero él no les hizo caso.

fr.L: Et même Elnathan et Delaya et Guemaria insistèrent auprès du roi pour qu’il ne brûle pas le rouleau, mais il ne les écouta pas.
fr.B: Elnathan, Delaya et Guemaria supplièrent même le roi de ne pas brûler le rouleau, mais il refusa de les écouter.
fr.R: Elnathan, Delaya et Guemaria ont même supplié le roi de ne pas brûler le rouleau, mais il n’a pas voulu les écouter.

sw.L: Tena Elnathani na Delaya na Gemaria walimsihi mfalme asilichome gombo, lakini hakuwasikiliza.
sw.B: Elnathani, Delaya na Gemaria walimsihi mfalme hata asilichome gombo, lakini alikataa kuwasikiliza.
sw.R: Elnathani, Delaya na Gemaria walimwomba sana mfalme asilichome gombo, lakini hakutaka kuwasikiliza.

vi.L: Ngay cả Ên-na-than, Đê-la-gia và Ghê-ma-ria nài xin vua đừng đốt cuộn sách, nhưng vua không nghe họ.
vi.B: Ên-na-than, Đê-la-gia và Ghê-ma-ria còn nài xin vua đừng đốt cuộn sách, nhưng vua không chịu nghe.
vi.R: Ên-na-than, Đê-la-gia và Ghê-ma-ria còn van xin vua đừng đốt cuộn sách, nhưng vua không chịu nghe họ.

ko.L: 그리고 엘라단과 들라야와 그마랴가 왕에게 그 두루마리를 불사르지 말라고 간청하기까지 했으나, 그는 그들의 말을 듣지 않았다.
ko.B: 엘라단과 들라야와 그마랴는 왕에게 두루마리를 불사르지 말라고 간곡히 청하기까지 했으나, 왕은 그들의 말을 듣지 않았다.
ko.R: 엘라단과 들라야와 그마랴는 두루마리를 태우지 말라고 왕에게 애원하기까지 했다. 그러나 왕은 그들의 말을 들으려 하지 않았다.

decisions.choice: urged: pressed the king with pleading
decisions.reason: The verb means to press upon someone, and so to plead or intercede (7:16; 27:18).

decisions.choice: Elnathan: the same official who had fetched Uriah for Jehoiakim
decisions.reason: Elnathan son of Achbor had carried out the king's order against the prophet Uriah (26:22-23). Now he joins those who plead for the scroll.

decisions.choice: refused to listen (B); would not listen (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say so because the king refused, not because he failed to hear.

source.text: וַיְצַוֶּ֣ה הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ אֶת־יְרַחְמְאֵ֨ל בֶּן־הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וְאֶת־שְׂרָיָ֣הוּ בֶן־עַזְרִיאֵ֗ל וְאֶת־שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּֽן־עַבְדְּאֵ֔ל לָקַ֨חַת֙ אֶת־בָּר֣וּךְ הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְאֵ֖ת יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא וַיַּסְתִּרֵ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And commanded the king Jerahmeel son of the king and Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; and hid them Yahweh.

en.L: And the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of the king, and Seraiah son of Azriel, and Shelemiah son of Abdeel, to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} hid them.
en.B: Instead, the king ordered Jerahmeel, the king's son, Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel to arrest Baruch the scribe and the prophet Jeremiah. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} hid them.
en.R: Instead, the king ordered three men to arrest Baruch the scribe and the prophet Jeremiah. They were Jerahmeel, the king's son, Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} hid Baruch and Jeremiah.

es.L: Y el rey mandó a Jerameel hijo del rey, y a Seraías hijo de Azriel, y a Selemías hijo de Abdeel, que prendieran a Baruc el escriba y a Jeremías el profeta; pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los escondió.
es.B: En cambio, el rey ordenó a Jerameel, hijo del rey, a Seraías hijo de Azriel y a Selemías hijo de Abdeel que arrestaran al escriba Baruc y al profeta Jeremías. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los escondió.
es.R: En cambio, el rey les ordenó a tres hombres que arrestaran al escriba Baruc y al profeta Jeremías. Eran Jerameel, hijo del rey, Seraías hijo de Azriel y Selemías hijo de Abdeel. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escondió a Baruc y a Jeremías.

fr.L: Et le roi ordonna à Yerahmeël, le fils du roi, et à Seraya fils d’Azriel, et à Shélémia fils d’Abdeel, de saisir Baruch le scribe et Jérémie le prophète ; mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les cacha.
fr.B: Au lieu de cela, le roi ordonna à Yerahmeël, le fils du roi, à Seraya fils d’Azriel et à Shélémia fils d’Abdeel d’arrêter Baruch le scribe et le prophète Jérémie. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les cacha.
fr.R: Au contraire, le roi a ordonné à trois hommes d’arrêter Baruch le scribe et le prophète Jérémie. C’étaient Yerahmeël, le fils du roi, Seraya fils d’Azriel et Shélémia fils d’Abdeel. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a caché Baruch et Jérémie.

sw.L: Naye mfalme akamwamuru Yerameeli mwana wa mfalme, na Seraya mwana wa Azrieli, na Shelemia mwana wa Abdeeli, wamkamate Baruku mwandishi na Yeremia nabii; lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawaficha.
sw.B: Badala yake mfalme akawaamuru Yerameeli mwana wa mfalme, Seraya mwana wa Azrieli na Shelemia mwana wa Abdeeli wamkamate Baruku mwandishi na nabii Yeremia. Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawaficha.
sw.R: Badala yake mfalme aliwaamuru watu watatu wamkamate Baruku mwandishi na nabii Yeremia. Hao walikuwa Yerameeli mwana wa mfalme, Seraya mwana wa Azrieli na Shelemia mwana wa Abdeeli. Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawaficha Baruku na Yeremia.

vi.L: Vua truyền cho Giê-rác-mê-ên con trai vua, Sê-ra-gia con trai Ách-ri-ên và Sê-lê-mia con trai Áp-đê-ên bắt Ba-rúc người chép sách và Giê-rê-mi nhà tiên tri; nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giấu họ đi.
vi.B: Trái lại, vua ra lệnh cho Giê-rác-mê-ên, hoàng tử, cùng Sê-ra-gia con trai Ách-ri-ên và Sê-lê-mia con trai Áp-đê-ên đi bắt Ba-rúc người chép sách và nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi. Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giấu họ.
vi.R: Trái lại, vua ra lệnh cho ba người đi bắt Ba-rúc người chép sách và nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi. Ba người ấy là Giê-rác-mê-ên, hoàng tử, Sê-ra-gia con trai Ách-ri-ên và Sê-lê-mia con trai Áp-đê-ên. Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giấu Ba-rúc và Giê-rê-mi.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 왕의 아들 여라므엘과 아스리엘의 아들 스라야와 압디엘의 아들 셀레먀에게 서기관 바룩과 예언자 예레미야를 잡으라고 명령했다. 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 숨기셨다.
ko.B: 오히려 왕은 왕자 여라므엘과 아스리엘의 아들 스라야와 압디엘의 아들 셀레먀에게 서기관 바룩과 예언자 예레미야를 체포하라고 명령했다. 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 숨기셨다.
ko.R: 오히려 왕은 세 사람에게 서기관 바룩과 예언자 예레미야를 잡아 오라고 명령했다. 그들은 왕자 여라므엘과 아스리엘의 아들 스라야와 압디엘의 아들 셀레먀였다. 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바룩과 예레미야를 숨겨 주셨다.

decisions.choice: the son of the king: a prince of the royal house, or a title of a royal officer
alternatives: a royal officer with the title "king's son"
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean one of the king's sons, or a member of the royal family given police duties, as with Malchiah "the son of the king" whose cistern held Jeremiah (38:6; 1 Kings 22:26). Jehoiakim was about thirty at this time, so a grown son is possible but uncertain.

decisions.choice: Baruch the scribe: a writer by trade, Jeremiah's scribe
decisions.reason: The same word names the royal secretary (verses 10, 12). Baruch held no court office; he was a trained scribe who wrote for Jeremiah (verse 32).

decisions.choice: the LORD hid them: their safety is the LORD's doing
decisions.reason: The officials had told them to hide (verse 19), but the narrator says that it was the LORD who hid them. The king's men could not find them.

decisions.choice: the scribe
decisions.reason: Every level says "scribe" for Baruch, keeping "secretary" for the royal office in verses 10-21 (m2).

decisions.choice: three men ... They were
decisions.reason: Readable gives the order first and the names in a second sentence, and names Baruch and Jeremiah for "them".

decisions.choice: el escriba (all levels)
decisions.reason: Baruch is a writer by trade, Jeremiah's scribe, not a royal secretary, so he is "escriba" at every level.

decisions.choice: Ba-rúc người chép sách
decisions.reason: Baruch is a writer by trade, Jeremiah's scribe. "Thư ký" is kept for the royal secretary and "thầy thông giáo" for the teacher of the law (Ezra), so Baruch is "người chép sách" at every level.

source.text: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ אַחֲרֵ֣י׀שְׂרֹ֣ף הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶת־הַמְּגִלָּה֙ וְאֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּתַ֥ב בָּר֛וּךְ מִפִּ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And came [the] word of Yahweh to Jeremiah after burned the king the scroll and the words that wrote Baruch from [the] mouth of Jeremiah, saying:

en.L: And the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to Jeremiah after the king had burned the scroll and the words that Baruch had written from the mouth of Jeremiah, saying:
en.B: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to Jeremiah after the king had burned the scroll, and with it the words Baruch had written as Jeremiah dictated:
en.R: After the king burned the scroll with the words Jeremiah had spoken and Baruch had written, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Jeremiah another message:

es.L: Y vino la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a Jeremías, después que el rey quemó el rollo y las palabras que Baruc había escrito de la boca de Jeremías, diciendo:
es.B: La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a Jeremías después de que el rey quemó el rollo, y con él las palabras que Baruc había escrito al dictado de Jeremías:
es.R: Después de que el rey quemó el rollo con las palabras que Jeremías había dicho y Baruc había escrito, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Jeremías otro mensaje:

fr.L: Et la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée à Jérémie, après que le roi eut brûlé le rouleau et les paroles que Baruch avait écrites de la bouche de Jérémie, disant :
fr.B: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée à Jérémie après que le roi eut brûlé le rouleau, et avec lui les paroles que Baruch avait écrites sous la dictée de Jérémie :
fr.R: Après que le roi a brûlé le rouleau avec les paroles que Jérémie avait dites et que Baruch avait écrites, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné un autre message à Jérémie :

sw.L: Ndipo neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likamjia Yeremia, baada ya mfalme kulichoma gombo na maneno aliyoyaandika Baruku kutoka kinywani mwa Yeremia, kusema:
sw.B: Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likamjia Yeremia baada ya mfalme kulichoma gombo, pamoja na maneno ambayo Baruku aliyaandika Yeremia alipokuwa akimsomea:
sw.R: Baada ya mfalme kulichoma gombo lenye maneno ambayo Yeremia aliyasema na Baruku akayaandika, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa Yeremia ujumbe mwingine:

vi.L: Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Giê-rê-mi sau khi vua đã đốt cuộn sách và những lời Ba-rúc đã chép từ miệng Giê-rê-mi, rằng:
vi.B: Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Giê-rê-mi sau khi vua đã đốt cuộn sách cùng những lời Ba-rúc đã chép theo lời Giê-rê-mi đọc:
vi.R: Sau khi vua đốt cuộn sách có chép những lời Giê-rê-mi đã nói và Ba-rúc đã viết, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Giê-rê-mi một sứ điệp khác:

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 그 두루마리와, 바룩이 예레미야의 입에서 받아 기록한 말들을 불사른 뒤에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예레미야에게 임하여 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 왕이 두루마리를, 곧 예레미야가 불러 주고 바룩이 받아 적은 말씀을 불사른 뒤에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예레미야에게 임했다.
ko.R: 예레미야가 말하고 바룩이 받아 적은 말씀이 담긴 두루마리를 왕이 불태운 뒤에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예레미야에게 다시 말씀을 주셨다.

decisions.choice: the scroll and the words: the king meant to destroy the message itself
decisions.reason: The verse names both what was burned, the scroll, and what the king tried to be rid of, the words. The LORD's answer is to have the words written again.

decisions.choice: from the mouth of Jeremiah: at his dictation
decisions.reason: As in verse 4.

decisions.choice: another message
decisions.reason: Readable says "another" to show that this is a new word after the burning, following the heading for "the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah".

source.text: שׁ֥וּב קַח־לְךָ֖ מְגִלָּ֣ה אַחֶ֑רֶת וּכְתֹ֣ב עָלֶ֗יהָ אֵ֤ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֗וּ עַל־הַמְּגִלָּה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂרַ֖ף יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Again take for yourself [a] scroll other and write on it all the words the former that were on the scroll the first which burned Jehoiakim king of Judah.

en.L: "Again take for yourself another scroll, and write on it all the former words that were on the first scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah burned.
en.B: "Take another scroll and write on it again all the words that were on the first scroll, the one that Jehoiakim king of Judah burned.
en.R: "Get another scroll. Write on it again all the words that were on the first scroll, the one King Jehoiakim of Judah burned.

es.L: «Vuelve a tomar para ti otro rollo, y escribe en él todas las palabras primeras que estaban en el primer rollo, que quemó Joacim rey de Judá.
es.B: «Toma otro rollo y escribe en él otra vez todas las palabras que estaban en el primer rollo, el que quemó Joacim, rey de Judá.
es.R: «Consigue otro rollo. Escribe en él otra vez todas las palabras que estaban en el primer rollo, el que quemó Joacim, rey de Judá.

fr.L: « Prends-toi encore un autre rouleau, et écris dessus toutes les paroles précédentes qui étaient sur le premier rouleau, que Joïaqim, roi de Juda, a brûlé.
fr.B: « Prends un autre rouleau et écris de nouveau dessus toutes les paroles qui étaient sur le premier rouleau, celui que Joïaqim, roi de Juda, a brûlé.
fr.R: « Procure-toi un autre rouleau. Écris de nouveau dessus toutes les paroles qui étaient sur le premier rouleau, celui que le roi Joïaqim de Juda a brûlé.

sw.L: "Jitwalie tena gombo jingine, uandike ndani yake maneno yote ya kwanza yaliyokuwa katika gombo la kwanza, ambalo Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda amelichoma.
sw.B: "Chukua gombo jingine, uandike tena ndani yake maneno yote yaliyokuwa katika gombo la kwanza, lile ambalo Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda amelichoma.
sw.R: "Chukua gombo jingine. Andika tena ndani yake maneno yote yaliyokuwa katika gombo la kwanza, lile ambalo mfalme Yehoyakimu wa Yuda alilichoma.

vi.L: "Hãy lấy cho ngươi một cuộn sách khác nữa, và chép vào đó mọi lời trước kia đã có trong cuộn sách thứ nhất mà Giê-hô-gia-kim vua Giu-đa đã đốt.
vi.B: "Con hãy lấy một cuộn sách khác và chép lại vào đó mọi lời đã có trong cuộn sách thứ nhất, là cuộn mà Giê-hô-gia-kim vua Giu-đa đã đốt.
vi.R: "Con hãy lấy một cuộn sách khác. Hãy chép lại vào đó mọi lời đã có trong cuộn sách thứ nhất, là cuộn mà vua Giê-hô-gia-kim của Giu-đa đã đốt.

ko.L: "너는 다시 다른 두루마리를 가져다가, 유다 왕 여호야김이 불사른 첫째 두루마리에 있던 이전의 모든 말을 거기에 기록하여라.
ko.B: "다른 두루마리를 가져다가, 유다 왕 여호야김이 불사른 첫째 두루마리에 있던 모든 말을 다시 거기에 적어라.
ko.R: "다른 두루마리를 가져오너라. 유다 왕 여호야김이 불태운 첫째 두루마리에 있던 말을 모두 거기에 다시 적어라.

decisions.choice: return, take: take again
decisions.reason: The verb "return" before another verb means doing it again. The command repeats the first one (verse 2).

decisions.choice: the former words on the first scroll: burning the scroll does not undo the message
decisions.reason: The LORD has the same words written again. What the king destroyed was leather or papyrus, not the word itself (compare Isaiah 40:8).

decisions.choice: again, placed with "write"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable attach "again" to the writing, where English expects it.

source.text: וְעַל־יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה֙ תֹּאמַ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אַ֠תָּה שָׂרַ֜פְתָּ אֶת־הַמְּגִלָּ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַדּוּעַ֩ כָּתַ֨בְתָּ עָלֶ֜יהָ לֵאמֹ֗ר בֹּֽא־יָב֤וֹא מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֙ וְהִשְׁחִית֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וְהִשְׁבִּ֥ית מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, Thus says Yahweh: You burned the scroll this, saying, Why did you write on it, saying, To come will come [the] king of Babylon and he will destroy the land this and cause to cease from it human and beast?

en.L: And concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: You burned this scroll, saying, "Why did you write on it, saying, 'The king of Babylon will surely come and destroy this land and cause human and beast to cease from it'?"'
en.B: And concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you are to say, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: You burned this scroll and said, "Why did you write on it that the king of Babylon is sure to come and destroy this land and wipe out both people and animals from it?"'
en.R: And this is what you must say about Jehoiakim king of Judah: 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: You burned this scroll. You asked, "Why did you write that the king of Babylon will surely come and destroy this land, and kill all the people and animals in it?"'

es.L: Y acerca de Joacim rey de Judá dirás: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Tú quemaste este rollo, diciendo: ‘¿Por qué escribiste en él, diciendo: Ciertamente vendrá el rey de Babilonia y destruirá esta tierra, y hará desaparecer de ella hombres y animales?’”.
es.B: Y acerca de Joacim, rey de Judá, dirás: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Tú quemaste este rollo y dijiste: ‘¿Por qué escribiste en él que el rey de Babilonia vendrá sin falta, destruirá esta tierra y acabará con hombres y animales?’”.
es.R: Y esto es lo que tienes que decir acerca de Joacim, rey de Judá: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Tú quemaste este rollo. Preguntaste: ‘¿Por qué escribiste que el rey de Babilonia vendrá sin falta y destruirá esta tierra, y matará a toda la gente y a todos los animales?’”.

fr.L: Et au sujet de Joïaqim, roi de Juda, tu diras : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Tu as brûlé ce rouleau, disant : ‘Pourquoi as-tu écrit dessus, disant : Le roi de Babylone viendra sûrement et détruira ce pays et en fera disparaître hommes et bêtes ?’”
fr.B: Et au sujet de Joïaqim, roi de Juda, tu diras : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Tu as brûlé ce rouleau en disant : ‘Pourquoi as-tu écrit dessus que le roi de Babylone viendra certainement détruire ce pays et en faire disparaître les humains et les animaux ?’”
fr.R: Et voici ce que tu diras au sujet de Joïaqim, roi de Juda : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Tu as brûlé ce rouleau. Tu as demandé : ‘Pourquoi as-tu écrit que le roi de Babylone viendra sûrement détruire ce pays et tuer tous les gens et tous les animaux qui y vivent ?’”

sw.L: Na kuhusu Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda utasema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Wewe umelichoma gombo hili, ukisema, "Mbona umeandika ndani yake, kusema, 'Hakika mfalme wa Babeli atakuja, naye ataiharibu nchi hii, na kukomesha ndani yake mwanadamu na mnyama'?"'
sw.B: Na kuhusu Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda utasema, 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Wewe umelichoma gombo hili ukisema, "Kwa nini umeandika ndani yake kwamba hakika mfalme wa Babeli atakuja na kuiharibu nchi hii, na kuwaondoa ndani yake watu na wanyama?"'
sw.R: Na hivi ndivyo utakavyosema kuhusu Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda: 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Wewe umelichoma gombo hili. Uliuliza, "Kwa nini uliandika kwamba hakika mfalme wa Babeli atakuja na kuiharibu nchi hii, na kuwaua watu wote na wanyama wote ndani yake?"'

vi.L: Còn về Giê-hô-gia-kim vua Giu-đa, ngươi sẽ nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Ngươi đã đốt cuộn sách này mà nói: "Sao ngươi lại chép vào đó rằng: 'Vua Ba-by-lôn chắc chắn sẽ đến, hủy diệt xứ này, và làm cho cả người lẫn thú vật dứt khỏi nó'?"'
vi.B: Còn về Giê-hô-gia-kim vua Giu-đa, con hãy nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Ngươi đã đốt cuộn sách này và nói: "Sao ngươi lại chép vào đó rằng vua Ba-by-lôn chắc chắn sẽ đến hủy diệt xứ này và quét sạch cả người lẫn thú vật khỏi xứ?"'
vi.R: Đây là điều con phải nói về Giê-hô-gia-kim vua Giu-đa: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ngươi đã đốt cuộn sách này. Ngươi đã hỏi: "Sao ngươi lại chép rằng vua Ba-by-lôn chắc chắn sẽ đến hủy diệt xứ này, và giết hết người lẫn thú vật trong xứ?"'

ko.L: 그리고 유다 왕 여호야김에 관하여 너는 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하십니다. 네가 이 두루마리를 불사르며 말했다. "너는 어찌하여 거기에 '바빌론 왕이 반드시 와서 이 땅을 멸망시키고 거기에서 사람과 짐승을 없앨 것이다'라고 기록하였느냐?"'
ko.B: 그리고 유다 왕 여호야김에 관하여 너는 이렇게 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. 너는 이 두루마리를 불사르며 말했다. "어찌하여 너는 바빌론 왕이 반드시 와서 이 땅을 멸망시키고 사람과 짐승을 모두 없애 버릴 것이라고 거기에 적었느냐?"'
ko.R: 그리고 유다 왕 여호야김에 관하여 너는 이렇게 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀입니다. 너는 이 두루마리를 불태웠다. 그리고 너는 "왜 바빌론 왕이 반드시 와서 이 땅을 멸망시키고 사람과 짐승을 모두 죽일 것이라고 적었느냐?" 하고 물었다.'

decisions.choice: concerning Jehoiakim: a message about the king, spoken to him
decisions.reason: The preposition means "concerning" or "to". The words that follow speak to Jehoiakim directly ("you burned"), so the message is for him, whether or not it was given to him in person.

decisions.choice: saying: the king's objection, said or thought
decisions.reason: "Saying" can introduce words spoken aloud or what someone thinks. By burning the scroll Jehoiakim gave his answer to it: he rejected the warning that Babylon would come.

decisions.choice: the king of Babylon will surely come: the message of 25:8-11
decisions.reason: This sums up what Jeremiah had said in the same year: the LORD would bring Nebuchadrezzar against the land and make it a waste (25:9-11). The verb is doubled for certainty.

decisions.choice: the scroll's words reported, not quoted
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the quotation inside the king's question, with marks for each level of speech. Balanced and Readable report the scroll's words with "that", to avoid a fourth set of quotation marks.

decisions.choice: wipe out both people and animals (B); kill all the people and animals (R)
decisions.reason: To "cause to cease" people and animals from the land is to leave none alive there.

decisions.choice: the words of the scroll reported inside Jehoiakim's question, without a third set of quotation marks
decisions.reason: Spanish uses « », “ ” and ‘ ’ for three levels of speech; the scroll's words, a fourth level, are given without marks.

decisions.choice: the scroll’s words without a further level of quotation marks at Literal
decisions.reason: French has only three levels of quotation marks (« », “ ”, ‘ ’); the words written on the scroll, a fourth level in the English Literal, follow a colon without marks.

decisions.choice: ngươi (to King Jehoiakim)
decisions.reason: God's word to the king who burned the scroll is a sentence of judgment, so it says "ngươi" at every level, as to the foreign kings; the terms note's "con" (B, R) is for a king God comforts, as Hezekiah and Josiah. A reviewer should confirm.

decisions.choice: The formula to the king in 합쇼체 ("말씀하십니다", "하시는 말씀입니다"), God's words in 해라체 ("너")
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for a message spoken to a king [2 Kings 20:1].

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל־יְהֽוֹיָקִים֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹא־יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֥וֹ יוֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֑ד וְנִבְלָתוֹ֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה מֻשְׁלֶ֔כֶת לַחֹ֥רֶב בַּיּ֖וֹם וְלַקֶּ֥רַח בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: Not will be to him [one] sitting on [the] throne of David, and his corpse will be thrown out to the heat by day and to the frost by night.

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: There will not be for him [one] sitting on the throne of David, and his corpse will be thrown out to the heat by day and to the frost by night.
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this about Jehoiakim king of Judah: No one of his line will sit on the throne of David, and his dead body will be thrown out to the heat of the day and the frost of the night.
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says about Jehoiakim king of Judah: No one from his family will sit on David's throne. His dead body will be thrown out and left in the heat of the day and the frost of the night.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de Joacim rey de Judá: No tendrá quien se siente sobre el trono de David, y su cadáver será echado al calor del día y a la helada de la noche.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto acerca de Joacim, rey de Judá: Nadie de su descendencia se sentará en el trono de David, y su cadáver será arrojado al calor del día y a la helada de la noche.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de Joacim, rey de Judá: Nadie de su familia se sentará en el trono de David. Su cadáver será arrojado y quedará expuesto al calor del día y a la helada de la noche.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de Joïaqim, roi de Juda : Il n’aura personne pour s’asseoir sur le trône de David, et son cadavre sera jeté dehors, à la chaleur le jour et au gel la nuit.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci au sujet de Joïaqim, roi de Juda : Aucun de ses descendants ne siégera sur le trône de David, et son cadavre sera jeté dehors, exposé à la chaleur du jour et au gel de la nuit.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de Joïaqim, roi de Juda : Personne de sa famille ne siégera sur le trône de David. Son cadavre sera jeté dehors et laissé à la chaleur du jour et au gel de la nuit.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi juu ya Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda: Hatakuwa na [mtu] wa kuketi katika kiti cha enzi cha Daudi, nayo maiti yake itatupwa nje kwenye joto la mchana na kwenye baridi kali ya usiku.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo kuhusu Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda: Hakuna hata mmoja wa uzao wake atakayeketi katika kiti cha enzi cha Daudi, nayo maiti yake itatupwa nje kwenye joto la mchana na baridi kali ya usiku.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema kuhusu Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda: Hakuna mtu wa jamaa yake atakayeketi katika kiti cha enzi cha Daudi. Maiti yake itatupwa nje na kuachwa katika joto la mchana na baridi kali ya usiku.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này về Giê-hô-gia-kim vua Giu-đa: Nó sẽ không có [người] ngồi trên ngai Đa-vít, và thây nó sẽ bị ném ra ngoài, chịu nắng nóng ban ngày và sương giá ban đêm.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy về Giê-hô-gia-kim vua Giu-đa: Không ai trong dòng dõi nó sẽ ngồi trên ngai Đa-vít, và xác nó sẽ bị ném ra ngoài, chịu nắng nóng ban ngày và sương giá ban đêm.
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán về Giê-hô-gia-kim vua Giu-đa: Không ai trong gia đình nó sẽ được ngồi trên ngai Đa-vít. Xác nó sẽ bị ném ra ngoài, nằm phơi dưới nắng nóng ban ngày và sương giá ban đêm.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다 왕 여호야김에 관하여 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 그에게는 다윗의 왕좌에 앉을 [사람이] 없을 것이며, 그의 시체는 내던져져 낮에는 더위를, 밤에는 서리를 맞을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다 왕 여호야김에 관하여 이렇게 말씀하신다. 그의 자손 가운데 다윗의 왕좌에 앉을 사람이 없을 것이며, 그의 시체는 내던져져서 낮에는 더위에, 밤에는 서리에 버려질 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다 왕 여호야김에 관하여 하시는 말씀이다. 그의 집안에서는 아무도 다윗의 왕좌에 앉지 못할 것이다. 그의 시체는 밖에 내던져져서 낮에는 뜨거운 햇볕을, 밤에는 차가운 서리를 맞으며 버려질 것이다.

decisions.choice: no one to sit on the throne of David: no lasting line of kings from Jehoiakim
decisions.reason: His son Jehoiachin reigned only three months before he was taken to Babylon (2 Kings 24:8-15), and no son of Jehoiachin ruled (22:30). The throne passed to Jehoiakim's brother Zedekiah.

decisions.choice: his corpse will be thrown out: an unburied death, as 22:18-19 had said
decisions.reason: Jeremiah had said that Jehoiakim would have "the burial of a donkey", dragged out and thrown beyond the gates (22:19). The heat and frost picture a body left unburied. Kings says only that he "lay down with his fathers" (2 Kings 24:6) and does not tell how he was buried.

decisions.choice: therefore: the sentence that follows from the king's act
decisions.reason: The LORD still speaks to Jeremiah, now about Jehoiakim in the third person. Because he burned the warning, the warning will come true for him and his house.

decisions.choice: of his line (B); from his family (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the one who will not sit on the throne is someone of Jehoiakim's own line (m1).

source.text: וּפָקַדְתִּ֨י עָלָ֧יו וְעַל־זַרְע֛וֹ וְעַל־עֲבָדָ֖יו אֶת־עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י עֲ֠לֵיהֶם וְעַל־יֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וְאֶל־אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֧ת כָּל־הָרָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will visit on him and on his seed and on his servants their iniquity, and I will bring on them and on [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem and to [the] men of Judah all the evil that I spoke against them, and not they listened.

en.L: And I will visit on him and on his offspring and on his servants their iniquity, and I will bring on them and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem and on the {{gender:people|men}} of Judah all the evil that I have spoken against them, and they did not listen."
en.B: I will punish him and his descendants and his officials for their guilt. I will bring on them, on those who live in Jerusalem and on the {{gender:people|men}} of Judah all the disaster I have pronounced against them, because they did not listen."
en.R: I will punish him, his children and his officials for their sin. I will bring on them, and on everyone who lives in Jerusalem and in Judah, all the disaster I warned them about, because they would not listen."

es.L: Y castigaré en él y en su descendencia y en sus siervos su iniquidad, y traeré sobre ellos y sobre los habitantes de Jerusalén y sobre {{gender:la gente|los hombres}} de Judá todo el mal que he hablado contra ellos, y no escucharon”».
es.B: Lo castigaré a él, a sus descendientes y a sus funcionarios por su culpa. Traeré sobre ellos, sobre los que viven en Jerusalén y sobre {{gender:la gente|los hombres}} de Judá toda la calamidad que he anunciado contra ellos, porque no escucharon”».
es.R: Lo castigaré a él, a sus hijos y a sus funcionarios por su pecado. Traeré sobre ellos y sobre todos los que viven en Jerusalén y en Judá toda la desgracia de la que les advertí, porque no quisieron escuchar”».

fr.L: Et je punirai sur lui, et sur sa descendance, et sur ses serviteurs, leur iniquité, et je ferai venir sur eux, et sur les habitants de Jérusalem, et sur les {{gender:gens|hommes}} de Juda, tout le mal que j’ai prononcé contre eux, et ils n’ont pas écouté. »
fr.B: Je le punirai, lui, ses descendants et ses officiers, pour leur faute. Je ferai venir sur eux, sur ceux qui habitent Jérusalem et sur les {{gender:gens|hommes}} de Juda, tout le malheur que j’ai annoncé contre eux, parce qu’ils n’ont pas écouté. »
fr.R: Je le punirai, lui, ses enfants et ses officiers, pour leur péché. Je ferai venir sur eux, et sur tous les habitants de Jérusalem et de Juda, tout le malheur dont je les ai avertis, parce qu’ils n’ont pas voulu écouter. »

sw.L: Nami nitapatiliza juu yake na juu ya uzao wake na juu ya watumishi wake uovu wao, nami nitaleta juu yao na juu ya wakaaji wa Yerusalemu na juu ya watu wa Yuda mabaya yote niliyoyasema juu yao, wala hawakusikiliza."
sw.B: Nitamwadhibu yeye na wazao wake na maafisa wake kwa sababu ya hatia yao. Nitaleta juu yao, juu ya wanaoishi Yerusalemu na juu ya watu wa Yuda maafa yote niliyoyatamka juu yao, kwa sababu hawakusikiliza."
sw.R: Nitamwadhibu yeye, watoto wake na maafisa wake kwa sababu ya dhambi yao. Nitaleta juu yao, na juu ya kila mtu anayeishi Yerusalemu na Yuda, maafa yote niliyowaonya juu yake, kwa sababu hawakutaka kusikiliza."

vi.L: Ta sẽ phạt nó, dòng dõi nó và các đầy tớ nó vì tội ác của chúng, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giáng trên chúng, trên dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem và trên người Giu-đa mọi tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán nghịch cùng chúng, mà chúng không nghe."
vi.B: Ta sẽ trừng phạt nó, dòng dõi nó và các triều thần của nó vì lỗi lầm của chúng. Ta sẽ giáng trên chúng, trên những người sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem và trên người Giu-đa mọi tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã tuyên phán nghịch cùng chúng, vì chúng đã không nghe."
vi.R: Ta sẽ trừng phạt nó, con cái nó và các triều thần của nó vì tội lỗi của chúng. Ta sẽ giáng trên chúng, trên mọi người sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem và tại Giu-đa, mọi tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cảnh báo, vì chúng đã không chịu nghe."

ko.L: 그리고 내가 그와 그의 자손과 그의 신하들에게 그들의 죄악을 벌하고, 그들과 예루살렘 주민들과 유다 사람들에게 내가 그들에게 선언한 모든 재앙을 내리겠다. 그들이 듣지 않았기 때문이다."
ko.B: 내가 그와 그의 자손과 그의 신하들을 그들의 죄악 때문에 벌하겠다. 내가 그들과 예루살렘에 사는 사람들과 유다 사람들에게 선언한 모든 재앙을 그들에게 내리겠다. 그들이 듣지 않았기 때문이다."
ko.R: 나는 그와 그의 자녀들과 그의 신하들을 그들의 죄 때문에 벌하겠다. 나는 그들과 예루살렘과 유다에 사는 모든 사람에게 내가 경고했던 모든 재앙을 내리겠다. 그들이 끝내 듣지 않았기 때문이다."

decisions.choice: visit their iniquity on him: punish him for his guilt
decisions.reason: To "visit" wrongdoing on someone is to call him to account for it and bring its punishment on him (Exodus 20:5).

decisions.choice: all the evil I have spoken: the disaster of verse 3, which the scroll was meant to turn aside
decisions.reason: The same word and phrase were used in verse 3, where the LORD hoped the people would turn. Now the "perhaps" has come to nothing.

decisions.choice: and they did not listen: the reason for the judgment
decisions.reason: The closing clause gives the cause of all that comes before it. It answers the hope of verses 3 and 7.

decisions.choice: the men of Judah: the people of Judah
decisions.reason: The word for "man" is used here for every person of Judah, as a whole people.

decisions.choice: descendants (B), children (R); officials; guilt (B), sin (R)
decisions.reason: "Seed" means offspring. The king's servants are his officials, and the word for iniquity follows the wording used for Isaiah. Literal keeps "offspring", "servants" and "iniquity".

decisions.choice: castigaré en él ... su iniquidad
decisions.reason: "Visit iniquity on" means to punish it; Literal says "castigar", the plain sense, since "visitar" does not carry it in Spanish.

decisions.choice: "nitapatiliza ... uovu wao" (L); "Nitamwadhibu ... kwa sababu ya hatia yao" (B); "Nitamwadhibu ... kwa sababu ya dhambi yao" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "visit iniquity on" with "kupatiliza", the Swahili word for visiting guilt on someone; Balanced and Readable say "punish". No gender span on "watu wa Yuda", which already means all the people.

decisions.choice: phạt (for "visit ... their iniquity")
decisions.reason: The idiom "visit iniquity on" means to punish; Literal says "phạt", as the published "thăm" would read as a friendly visit in modern Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: "그들의 죄악을 벌하고" for "visit on him their iniquity" at Literal
decisions.reason: Korean cannot keep the verb "visit" in this sense; "벌하다" is the meaning the decision gives, and Literal keeps the word order of the persons.

source.text: וְיִרְמְיָ֜הוּ לָקַ֣ח׀מְגִלָּ֣ה אַחֶ֗רֶת וַֽיִּתְּנָהּ֮ אֶל־בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־נֵרִיָּהוּ֮ הַסֹּפֵר֒ וַיִּכְתֹּ֤ב עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֣י הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂרַ֛ף יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּאֵ֑שׁ וְע֨וֹד נוֹסַ֧ף עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם דְּבָרִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים כָּהֵֽמָּה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And Jeremiah took [a] scroll other and gave it to Baruch son of Neriah the scribe, and he wrote on it from [the] mouth of Jeremiah all [the] words of the book that had burned Jehoiakim king of Judah in the fire; and yet were added to them words many like them.

en.L: And Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to Baruch son of Neriah, the scribe, and he wrote on it from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and many words like them were added to them besides.
en.B: Then Jeremiah took another scroll and handed it to Baruch son of Neriah, the scribe. As Jeremiah dictated, Baruch wrote on it every word of the scroll that King Jehoiakim of Judah had burned in the fire, and many other words like them were added.
en.R: So Jeremiah got another scroll and gave it to Baruch son of Neriah, the scribe. Jeremiah spoke, and Baruch wrote on the new scroll all the words that had been on the scroll King Jehoiakim burned. Many more messages like them were added as well.

es.L: Y Jeremías tomó otro rollo y se lo dio a Baruc hijo de Nerías, el escriba, y él escribió en él de la boca de Jeremías todas las palabras del rollo que Joacim rey de Judá había quemado en el fuego; y además se les añadieron muchas palabras semejantes.
es.B: Entonces Jeremías tomó otro rollo y se lo entregó a Baruc hijo de Nerías, el escriba. Al dictado de Jeremías, Baruc escribió en él todas las palabras del rollo que el rey Joacim de Judá había quemado en el fuego, y se añadieron además muchas otras palabras semejantes.
es.R: Así que Jeremías consiguió otro rollo y se lo dio a Baruc hijo de Nerías, el escriba. Jeremías hablaba, y Baruc escribía en el nuevo rollo todas las palabras que habían estado en el rollo que quemó el rey Joacim. También se añadieron muchos otros mensajes parecidos.

fr.L: Et Jérémie prit un autre rouleau et le donna à Baruch fils de Nériya, le scribe, et il écrivit dessus, de la bouche de Jérémie, toutes les paroles du livre que Joïaqim, roi de Juda, avait brûlé au feu ; et beaucoup de paroles semblables y furent encore ajoutées.
fr.B: Alors Jérémie prit un autre rouleau et le remit à Baruch fils de Nériya, le scribe. Sous la dictée de Jérémie, Baruch y écrivit toutes les paroles du rouleau que le roi Joïaqim de Juda avait brûlé au feu, et beaucoup d’autres paroles semblables y furent ajoutées.
fr.R: Jérémie a donc pris un autre rouleau et l’a donné à Baruch fils de Nériya, le scribe. Jérémie parlait, et Baruch écrivait sur le nouveau rouleau toutes les paroles qui étaient sur le rouleau brûlé par le roi Joïaqim. On y a aussi ajouté beaucoup d’autres messages semblables.

sw.L: Ndipo Yeremia akachukua gombo jingine, akampa Baruku mwana wa Neria, mwandishi, naye akaandika ndani yake kutoka kinywani mwa Yeremia maneno yote ya kitabu kile ambacho Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda alikichoma motoni; tena yakaongezwa juu yake maneno mengi mfano wa hayo.
sw.B: Basi Yeremia akachukua gombo jingine, akampa Baruku mwana wa Neria, mwandishi. Yeremia alipokuwa akimsomea, Baruku akaandika ndani yake kila neno la gombo lile ambalo mfalme Yehoyakimu wa Yuda alikuwa amelichoma motoni, na maneno mengine mengi kama hayo yakaongezwa.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Yeremia akachukua gombo jingine, akampa Baruku mwana wa Neria, mwandishi. Yeremia akasema, naye Baruku akaandika katika gombo jipya maneno yote yaliyokuwa katika gombo lile ambalo mfalme Yehoyakimu alilichoma. Jumbe nyingine nyingi kama hizo ziliongezwa pia.

vi.L: Giê-rê-mi lấy một cuộn sách khác, trao cho Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia, người chép sách, và ông chép vào đó từ miệng Giê-rê-mi mọi lời của cuộn sách mà Giê-hô-gia-kim vua Giu-đa đã đốt trong lửa; lại còn thêm vào đó nhiều lời khác giống như vậy.
vi.B: Rồi Giê-rê-mi lấy một cuộn sách khác trao cho Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia, người chép sách. Theo lời Giê-rê-mi đọc, Ba-rúc chép vào đó mọi lời của cuộn sách mà vua Giê-hô-gia-kim của Giu-đa đã đốt trong lửa, và còn thêm vào nhiều lời khác giống như vậy.
vi.R: Vậy Giê-rê-mi lấy một cuộn sách khác và trao cho Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia, người chép sách. Giê-rê-mi nói, và Ba-rúc chép vào cuộn sách mới mọi lời đã có trong cuộn sách vua Giê-hô-gia-kim đã đốt. Nhiều sứ điệp khác giống như vậy cũng được thêm vào.

ko.L: 그리고 예레미야가 다른 두루마리를 가져다가 네리야의 아들 서기관 바룩에게 주었다. 그러자 그가 거기에 유다 왕 여호야김이 불에 사른 책의 모든 말을 예레미야의 입에서 받아 기록했다. 그리고 그와 같은 많은 말이 거기에 더 보태어졌다.
ko.B: 그래서 예레미야는 다른 두루마리를 가져다가 네리야의 아들 서기관 바룩에게 주었다. 바룩은 예레미야가 불러 주는 대로, 유다 왕 여호야김이 불에 태운 두루마리의 모든 말을 거기에 적었다. 그리고 그와 비슷한 다른 많은 말이 거기에 더해졌다.
ko.R: 그래서 예레미야는 다른 두루마리를 가져다가 네리야의 아들 서기관 바룩에게 주었다. 예레미야가 말하고, 바룩은 여호야김 왕이 불태운 두루마리에 있던 말을 모두 새 두루마리에 적었다. 그리고 그와 비슷한 말씀이 더 많이 덧붙여졌다.

decisions.choice: were added: by Jeremiah through Baruch, though no one is named
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. The words came from Jeremiah, as the rest of the scroll did, and Baruch wrote them.

decisions.choice: many words like them: the second scroll held more than the first
decisions.reason: Burning the scroll did not silence the word; the new scroll was fuller. "Like them" means of the same kind: more warnings and calls to turn back.

decisions.choice: the second scroll and the book of Jeremiah
decisions.reason: This verse tells how Jeremiah's words were written down and added to. It shows part of the way the book itself took shape, though it does not say which chapters the scroll held.

decisions.choice: as Jeremiah dictated (B); Jeremiah spoke, and Baruch wrote (R); messages (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 4. Readable says "messages" for "words", since whole oracles were added.
